Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

We believe transportation is more than movement, it’s the foundation of connected, thriving communities. As part of HDR’s Transportation Business Group, you’ll help shape the systems that move people and goods safely, efficiently, and sustainably. From designing resilient highways and iconic bridges to advancing transit, passenger and freight rail, aviation, federal transportation ports and marine infrastructure, your work will directly support economic vitality, public safety, sustainable and resilient communities and quality of life. We bring together planners, engineers, architects, construction management staff, environmental, strategic communications, economists, management consultants and specialists across disciplines to solve complex mobility challenges with innovation, technical excellence, and a deep understanding of community needs. Whether you're modernizing aging infrastructure or pioneering next-generation transportation solutions, your contributions will help define the future of mobility. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead progress, drive meaningful impact, and leave a legacy of smarter, more connected transportation networks. We are all employee-owners at HDR, which is the foundation of our collaborative culture that connects employees around the world.

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

HDR’s Advanced Technologies for Surface Transportation group (ATST) is seeking a Tolling Project Manager to join our growing team. The primary responsibilities are to lead toll systems and roadside project delivery, and support transportation clients in toll planning, procurement, development, design, operations, and change management. In addition, the successful candidate will also assist in business development and growing HDR’s tolling business and be responsible for development of scopes, schedules, and budgets for tolling related projects. The successful candidate will supervise and support the development and growth of junior level staff.

At this point in your career, you know what you’re looking for in your next role: A solid company with collaborative colleagues that do interesting and unique work for clients that trust them to push open the doors to what’s possible. That’s what you’ll find at HDR.

We are an employee-owned company with more than 100 years of making great things possible together with our clients. Yes, we have the industry awards to prove it, but our pride is in our people. Smart, hardworking team members who take their employee ownership seriously and will have your back at every turn. Their expertise will motivate you to be your best and develop new and better solutions.

In the role of Tolling Project Manager, we'll count on you to:

Technical Delivery

Provide oversight and/or manage toll systems and toll technology projects including planning, engineering, design, deployment, integration, testing, commissioning, operations, maintenance, communications and overall management.
Design and development of tolling concepts and reports including development of roadside and back-office system requirements, specifications, and performance metrics.
Review and assessment of tolling solutions including the development of independent cost estimates, accuracy assessments, and feasibility. Develop and manage scopes of work, cost estimates, procurement documents, contract documents, and provide oversight of project tasks, deliverables, and sub-contracts.
Support design-build procurement processes and/or general program management contracts for toll related work elements including direct interaction with clients, and manage project meetings, design reviews, operations, project production and delivery.
Prepare and/or perform technical review of toll systems planning studies, engineering analyses, Concepts of Operations, and implementation plans; communications and operating systems.
Develop and/or review system integration plans, testing procedures and commissioning documents for toll systems.
Support field work with technical staff to collect site specific data as projects require
Assist with the design & implementation of toll related ITS projects including national ITS Standards, Active Traffic Management, communications systems, power distribution networks, and traffic control equipment.

Program Development

Assist with the development of local HDR office transportation programs and serve as a technical expert nationally.
Establish client relations and be involved with marketing, contract administration, and design and production meetings
Leverage work-share opportunities and coordinate workload with HDR business class managers locally and nationally
Implement HDR’s QA/QC procedures
Support in the recruitment, hiring and technical training for junior staff
Perform other duties as needed

Preferred Qualifications

Degree in Civil, Electrical, Systems, Software Engineering, or related engineering field
7+ years of experience in the tolling, systems, and/or revenue collection industry
2+ years of project management experience
Familiarity with toll collection technologies and equipment, electronic payment systems, video systems, toll infrastructure, traffic management, information and communication technologies for toll system design and operations
Proven leadership, project management, business development, technical writing, communications, and mentoring skills
Experience working with multiple state DOTs/ regions and Toll / Thruway / Turnpike Authorities.
Master’s in business administration
Involvement in professional organizations in the tolling and transportation technology field such as IBTTA and ITS America
Preference given to candidates currently residing in the Mid-Atlantic (MD / VA / DC) Area

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in related field
7 years related experience
A minimum of 2 years project management experience
Must have the ability to interact with various design teams, have excellent organizational, project management and communication (both written and verbal) skills
An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must

What We Believe

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

Our Commitment

As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.

Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees.

We provide a comprehensive benefits package that promotes employee ownership, employee health, performance, and success, which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life insurance, an employee assistance program, paid time away, parental leave, paid holidays, a retirement savings plan with employer match, employee referral bonus and tuition reimbursement. This is a 12 months fixed-term contract.

The Last Mile DSP Payments team wants a Program Manager who’s ready to dive in, get their hands dirty, and learn payments operations from the inside out.

EU DSP Payments moves more than €1B a year across 9 countries — and you’ll get a real, bounded piece of that world to call your own. jobs.description:
Company Description

At KPFF Consulting Engineers
, we are more than just an engineering design firm
. For over 60 years
, we have dedicated ourselves to innovative, sustainable engineering
that shapes the built environment
and tackles complex infrastructure challenges
. Our team culture
emphasizes balance, growth, and well-being
, supporting each member’s professional journey with flexibility, generous benefits,
and a collaborative approach
to work-life integration.

With over 1,400 professionals across 27 offices nationwide
, KPFF’s decentralized structure
allows each office the flexibility to pursue projects
aligned with their regional strengths
. Learn more at www.kpff.com
.

Job Description

We are seeking a Structural Project Manager to join our team and contribute to a wide range of projects, including civic and institutional buildings, healthcare facilities, residential construction, and research laboratory structures. The Structural Project Manager will not only perform technical tasks such as performing structural analysis and seismic design, developing construction documents, and supporting projects through all phases from planning and permitting to construction; but also supervise others throughout the process. The role involves both technical design and collaboration across disciplines, with opportunities for leadership and mentorship.

What You Will Be Doing

Designing gravity, lateral, and foundation systems (shallow and deep foundations) for new buildings and retrofit projects in high seismic hazard zones.
Performing structural analysis and seismic design using finite element analysis (FEA) software such as ETABS, RISA, SAFE, and RAM Steel.
Designing main building systems—including columns, beams, footings, diaphragms—and secondary systems such as anchorage, bracing, partitions, and retaining walls.
Analyzing and designing structural members in concrete, steel, and masonry using hand calculations and software (Enercalc, spCol) in compliance with ACI 318, AISC 360, and TMS 402/602 standards.
Designing new concrete, steel, and masonry structures in accordance with ASCE 7 and the California Building Code (CBC), and developing retrofit schemes for existing buildings in accordance with ASCE 41 and the California Existing Building Code (CEBC).
Producing comprehensive calculation packages, structural drawings, and details for permit and construction.
Supporting Construction Administration activities, including submittal review, RFI coordination, and drawing development.
Collaborating with the BIM department to maintain organizational standards for drawing production.
Coordinating with project managers, architects, and other engineering disciplines to ensure integrated project delivery.
Providing technical guidance and oversight to junior engineers to ensure conformance with project design requirements.
Supervising project engineers and design engineers in construction administration tasks and ensuring quality control of construction documents.

Salary

Pay Range $115,000-$150,000 salary depending on education, licensure, and applicable experience.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Seven years of full-time work experience as an engineer in a structural consulting organization.
BS in Civil Engineering (with an emphasis in Structures)
At least a 3.0 cumulative GPA in Undergraduate coursework
Transcripts showing completed courses in:
Structural Analysis
Mechanics of Materials
Concrete
Steel or Wood Design
Professional Engineer (PE) license

Preferred Qualifications

Seven years of full-time work experience as an engineer in a structural consulting organization.
Five years of experience training and supervising junior engineers.
Two years of experience as a Structural Project Manager in a structural consulting organization.
Master’s degree in Structural Engineering or in Civil Engineering with an emphasis in Structures.
At least a 3.0 cumulative GPA in Graduate coursework
Transcripts showing completed graduate level courses in:
Structural Design
Steel or Wood Design
Concrete
Seismic
Professional Engineer (PE) license in California
Structural Engineer (SE) License in California.
Proficiency in FEA and structural design software, including ETABS, RISA, SAFE, RAM Steel, Enercalc, and spCol.
Strong knowledge of relevant codes and standards, including ACI 318, AISC 360, TMS 402/602, ASCE 7, ASCE 41, CBC, and CEBC.
Ability to design multiple structural materials (concrete, steel, CMU, wood).
Experience with managing HCAI/OSHPD projects and/or DSA projects.
Experience developing retrofit schemes for existing structures.
Experience designing healthcare, laboratory, or other highly regulated facilities.
Solid understanding of seismic design principles and experience working in high seismic hazard zones.
Skilled in preparing and overseeing the preparation of technical documents, structural drawings, and calculation packages.
This person oversees, coordination, and communication for cross-team collaboration, and also actively performs these actions.
Experience in managing successful profitable project budgets.
Ability to supervise and mentor engineers and provide quality control oversight.
Strong organizational and time-management abilities to balance multiple projects.

Additional Information

Application Process

If you are interested in this position, please apply on our careers page. Resumes sent elsewhere will not be considered.

Please Provide Transcripts For All Undergraduate And Graduate Courses As Well As a Cover Letter. In Your Cover Letter (PDF) Please Respond To The Following Prompts

Describe a time when you were assigned a project or task that turned out to be really difficult. How did you work through it, and what was the outcome?
Who has most influenced you and why?

Physical Demands and Work Environment

Duties are performed in a normal office environment while sitting at a desk or computer table.
Duties require the ability to actively engage with a computer for several hours per day.
May occasionally need to lift items up to 15 lbs.
Duties require in-person attendance, Monday through Friday, during our business hours of 8 AM to 5 PM at our office in Downtown Los Angeles for the training period.
Following a satisfactory training period a hybrid schedule of 2 days per week in the office may be accommodated.

Our Offices

Our Greater Los Angeles Structural office has two locations at the Bloc in Downtown Los Angeles and at the Irvine Towers in Irvine. A warm and friendly environment, we are dedicated to growing with our employees and allowing people to pursue their passions.

KPFF Consulting Engineers participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

Our Employees

Are valued and empowered, collaborative and team oriented, innovative in their approach and passionate about their work. They are reliable, trustworthy, and open with a high level of integrity. They value diversity, are inclusive and are committed to critically thinking through problems and finding solutions.

Senior Program Manager, Product Technology

Overview

Patagonia is in business to save our home planet, and Product is central to how we bring that mission to life. The Product Technology team enables the people, processes, and tools that help Patagonia create industry-leading products known for performance, quality, durability, and responsibility. We are looking for a Program Manager to help advance this work by leading meaningful cross-functional programs, strengthening portfolio execution and visibility, and creating the alignment, structure, and focus teams need to deliver outcomes that matter.

In this role, you will report to the Senior Director of Product Technology and guide mid- to large-scale initiatives that support key departmental and company priorities. You will work with a cross-functional group of product teammates, multiple technology functions and domains, and business partners across Innovation, Design, DPC, Materials, Line Management, Marketing, Planning, Footprint, Creative, and others. You will help teams navigate complexity, clarify decisions, identify and resolve risks, improve ways of working, and connect day-to-day execution to Patagonia’s broader mission. We seek candidates who are energized by purposeful technology, collaborative problem solving, thoughtful program leadership, and the opportunity to shape the future of product creation at Patagonia.

What You’ll Do

Lead multiple high-impact programs and/or projects that align to business goals, KPIs, and expected outcomes, while supporting development of integrated roadmaps and governance artifacts that help teams plan, execute, and measure progress.
Drive program execution through established and evolving delivery frameworks, ensuring cross-team commitment, clear handoffs, dependency resolution, and acceptance of key deliverables.
Facilitate and continuously improve recurring portfolio reviews that assess project health, surface risks and dependencies, and keep teammates and stakeholders aligned on status, decisions, and next steps.
Guide teams through change, ambiguity, and conflict by helping clarify issues, resolve tradeoffs, and develop mitigation plans that support execution across teams.
Lead the development and execution of program and portfolio communications and performance reporting for stakeholder audiences, ensuring clarity and buy-in on key decisions and next steps.
Establish scalable program management standards, reusable playbooks, practices, and retrospectives that strengthen consistency across teams and help others apply effective project and program management methods.
Partner with cross-functional team members, managers, and key decision-makers to align scope, priorities, and department-level KPIs.
Facilitate the annual planning process for team initiatives, including intake, scoping, prioritization, business case development, and submission.
As an individual contributor, conduct your work in alignment with Patagonia’s Leadership Expectations - Leading Self principles: Build People + Teams, Drive Results, Demonstrate Good Judgement, and Champions Vision + Purpose.

Who You Are

Organized: Uses structured planning, prioritization, documentation, reporting, task management, and communication practices to support project execution, visibility, and timely delivery.
Collaborative: Builds strong, service-oriented partnerships across teams and levels by leading with empathy, embracing clarity, aligning partners on next steps, and keeping cross-functional work moving.
Curious: Seeks to understand new things, asks thoughtful questions, and looks for practical and creative ways to solve problems.
Influential: Drives alignment on complex, cross-functional decisions by applying business and technical insight, reframing challenges, and guiding strategy across teams and priorities.
Team-Oriented: Embraces shared ownership, stays flexible and nimble as priorities evolve, and is willing to wear multiple hats or support varied work as needed to achieve the outcome.
Product-Minded: Appreciates the craft, quality, and responsibility behind Patagonia products while bringing a strong bias toward the people who create them and a genuine care for how teams, decisions, and outcomes support product creation.
Passionate: Champions Patagonia’s mission to save our home planet and integrates this passion into all aspects of work.

Experience You Bring

8+ years of project and/or program design and management experience, including leading multiple high-impact projects or programs and executing integrated roadmaps and governance artifacts.
Demonstrated experience planning and delivering against complex and cross-functional projects and/or programs utilizing established methodologies and techniques, including forced-rank prioritization, resource planning, and timeline alignment to meet delivery goals.
Experience developing and enforcing program and portfolio management standards, metrics, and reusable, scalable practices across teams.
Proven ability to lead scaled risk assessments across teams, anticipate interdependencies, and develop and implement comprehensive mitigation plans.
Strong communication and change-management skills, including guiding stakeholder alignment and reporting for leadership audiences.
Expertise with Microsoft Office applications and project/program management software (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, Project, Azure DevOps, JIRA, ClickUp, FigJam).
Experience using AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, or similar platforms to generate and analyze content, improve decision support, and streamline day-to-day workflows.
Hands-on working experience in digital workspace platforms and knowledge/record management tools including Confluence and SharePoint.
Prior experience working in a consumer product/retail brand environment, preferably with product creation and/or product creation systems/tools experience.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is a plus.
Experience leading projects or programs within the Apparel, Retail or Multi-Channel industries is preferred.

Hiring range:
$132,175 - $147,725 USD Annual

At Patagonia, pay ranges are assigned to a job based on the location specific market median of similar jobs according to 3rd party salary benchmark surveys. Individual pay within that range can vary for several reasons including skills/capabilities, experience, and available budget.

Workplace Location Overview

This position is Hybrid, with a standard schedule of Tuesday - Thursday on-site and remote work on other days. Occasional additional office visits may be required for team events or critical meetings.

Benefits

Patagonia offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, retirement and leave of absence plans. Benefit plans may vary slightly depending on the nature of your employment.

Employee Conduct

It is the responsibility of every employee to contribute to a positive, inclusive work environment through cooperative and professional interactions with co-workers, customers and vendors.

Fieldpiece
is the innovation leader in professional HVACR test instruments, trusted by technicians around the world to solve some of the industry's toughest challenges. , we're looking for talented people who want to make an impact while growing their careers.

Why This Role?

Great products don't happen by accident - they happen because exceptional leaders bring people, ideas, and execution together.

As our Senior Program Manager
, you'll lead some of Fieldpiece's most strategic new product initiatives while helping transform how we develop products. You'll help redefine how an entire company develops products while bringing innovative connected technologies to market faster than ever before.
Shape the future of product development at an innovation-driven company building the next-generation of connected HVACR products by applying FTTM methodologies to accelerate innovation.
Influence both what we build to solve real customer problems and how we build them.

Successfully lead multiple new product development programs through key development milestones.

Strong understanding of the product development lifecycle, including both hardware development and software development processes.
Experience working with global suppliers, ODMs, contract manufacturers, and overseas manufacturing partners.

Work alongside talented, collaborative teammates who are passionate about innovation and solving real world problems.

This role sits at the center of Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supplier Development, translating program milestones into supply chain action and keeping production continuity on track through every ramp, launch, and shortage event.

This is a high-visibility, hands-on role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, builds structure where none exists yet, and is comfortable being the single point of accountability for supply readiness on a fast-moving vehicle program.

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end supply chain planning for new product launches and platform ramps, from early design through first-unit shipment and into steady-state production.
Develop and maintain the master NPI / launch timing plan from sourcing through SOP/SORP and ramp-up.
Establish and continuously improve standardized NPI/SCPM methodologies, phase-gate processes, and repeatable playbooks, defining clear roles, escalation paths, and standard work across programs.
Champion for MRP and ISO implementation for the supply chain organization.
Drive shortage management: identify at-risk parts, coordinate expedites and alternate sourcing, and keep production lines running through supply disruptions.
Partner with Engineering to translate design and BOM changes into scalable sourcing and manufacturing plans, and manage the supply chain impact of ECOs/PCOs.
Coordinate cross-functionally across Procurement, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supplier Development to align supply readiness with production build schedules.
Own program-level supply chain schedules, identify critical-path material risks, and proactively mitigate them before they impact the line.
Serve as the central point of contact for your program(s), running status meetings and delivering summaries of risks, decisions needed, and progress.

Required Skills & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience), with 3+ years of experience in supply chain program management, project management, or operations—ideally within automotive, EV, aerospace, or related manufacturing environments.
Experience supporting new product introduction (NPI) programs from concept through production handoff.
Demonstrated success managing shortages and material readiness for production continuity.
Experience with ERP systems and supply chain data/reporting tools (e.g., Oracle, advanced Excel).
Strong track record leading complex, cross-functional projects, with the excellent written and verbal communication skills needed to align internal teams and suppliers.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with vertically integrated manufacturing environments and the interplay between in-house production and outside suppliers.
Knowledge of automotive or commercial vehicle supply chain KPIs and quality/compliance frameworks.
Familiarity with program management methodologies.
Experience standing up or improving program management processes and reporting cadences in a scaling organization.
Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

jobs.description:
Data Analyst I

Applied General Agency

Location: Remote

About Applied General Agency

Applied General Agency was founded by Patrick Rodriguez in 1993. Headquartered in Anaheim, California, AGA has become one of the largest Medicare-focused independent marketing organizations in the nation. AGA was created with the intention of providing unparalleled value to overworked agents who had more obligations than time. With the support of a full back-office team, AGA has the vision and tools to make quality agents even more successful. AGA has grown to support close to 10,000 agents in serving the needs of half a million Americans nationwide. For more information, visit www.appliedga.com.

Job Summary

AGA is seeking a Data Analyst I to support the business by extracting, analyzing, and visualizing data to identify trends and inform decision-making. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand their data needs and deliver actionable insights through reports and dashboards. This is a great opportunity for a detail-oriented individual with a passion for data to contribute to AGA’s success.

Primary Responsibilities

Data Extraction & Cleaning: Gather data from various internal and external sources, ensuring data accuracy and integrity through cleaning, validation, and transformation.
Reporting & Dashboard Development: Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI to visualize key performance indicators (KPIs).
Ad-Hoc Reporting & Analysis: Respond to ad-hoc data requests from business stakeholders, providing timely and accurate reports based on user requests.
Documentation: Document data sources, methodologies, and analytical processes to ensure transparency and reproducibility.
Collaboration with Business Stakeholders: Partner with business users to understand their data needs and translate them into analytical solutions.
Support Financial Forecasting: Assist in the development and refinement of financial forecasting models by providing data analysis and insights.

Miller Kaplan is a different kind of CPA firm; we believe in building a legacy—yours. Job Summary

The Junior Data Analyst in the Data Analytics Department supports both external client engagements and internal practice groups by delivering data-driven insights and solutions. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to high-impact projects, collaborate across teams, and develop analytical expertise within a fast-growing practice area. Success in this role requires the ability to prioritize effectively and perform in a fast paced, deadline driven environment while communicating with the team.

Supervisory Responsibilities

None.

Duties/Responsibilities

Examine collected data to identify trends, outliers, and patterns, providing actionable insights to enhance client efficiency, profitability, or other specified objectives.
Gather and organize data from a variety of sources, including departmental heads, subject matter experts, reports, surveys, forecasts, and budgetary documentation, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
Convert reports into structured databases.
Design and implement secure, efficient, and accurate databases.
Perform data cleaning, transformation, and normalization to ensure consistency and accuracy.
Maintain data integrity and quality controls through validation checks and auditing.
Assist with query development (SQL) to support reporting and analysis.
Document database processes, definitions, and data dictionaries for transparency.
Collaborate with senior analysts or IT teams to support database performance tuning and troubleshooting.
Ensure compliance with data security, privacy, and access control.
Assist in developing and maintaining Python scripts to automate recurring data tasks, reporting, and file processing.
Support the development of ETL workflows that automate data cleaning, validation, and reconciliation to convert raw data into structured, reliable formats.
Apply basic VBA scripting within Excel to streamline reports, calculations, and client deliverables.
Document automation steps and maintain clear records for knowledge sharing and future improvements.
Retrieve, organize, and analyze data from databases to produce accurate and actionable reports.
Build and maintain interactive dashboards in Power BI, using visualization best practices to highlight key metrics and business trends.
Develop automated reporting solutions to reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
Present findings to management and clients with clear, data-driven insights that support decision-making.
Identify potential strategies to address issues uncovered during data analysis and provide well-reasoned suggestions for improvement.
Stay current on best practices and emerging trends in data storage, management, and analytics to ensure the firm utilizes state-of-the-art solutions, as well as the ability to apply new knowledge quickly.
Participate in the planning, execution, and monitoring of data-driven projects, ensuring timely and successful completion.
Work closely with team members, clients, and other stakeholders to support data-related initiatives and provide actionable recommendations.
Demonstrate the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver accurate work in a fast paced, deadline driven environment.
Perform other related duties and projects as assigned.

Required

Education and Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Economics, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Quantitative Analysis, or related field.

Required Skills/Abilities

Strong analytical thinking with high attention to detail and accuracy.
Effective communication and presentation skills for staff and stakeholders at all levels.
Excellent organizational and time management skills; able to work independently and proactively.
Proficient in Microsoft Excel (formulas, pivots, Power Query, Power Pivot, DAX, M Code) and the broader Microsoft Office Suite.
Proficient in programming with Python or SQL.
Proficient with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Understanding of database design, structure, and query languages.

Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred

Experience with relevant Python libraries (e.g., pandas, tkinter, openpyxl/xlwings, numpy, PDFplumber, sk-learn).
Experience with Machine Learning models and methodologies (Supervised/Unsupervised).
Familiarity with OCR methodologies and tools.
Familiarity with VBA (Visual Basic).
Familiarity with Azure fundamentals.
Prompt engineering and efficient use of utilizing AI.
Some exposure to Caseware IDEA software or similar audit/analytics tools.

jobs.title: Program Manager (French Speaking), Amazon Music International Product
jobs.description:
Description

Français:

Amazon Music est un service de divertissement audio immersif qui connecte les fans, les

artistes et les créateurs. Des playlists personnalisées aux podcasts exclusifs, en passant par la

diffusion de concerts en direct et les produits dérivés des artistes, Amazon Music innove à

l’intersection entre musique et culture. Nous proposons des expériences adaptées à tous les

auditeurs grâce à nos différentes offres : les membres Prime bénéficient d'un accès sans

publicité à l'ensemble du catalogue musical en mode aléatoire, ainsi qu'aux meilleurs

podcasts sans publicité, le tout inclus dans leur abonnement ; les clients peuvent opter pour

Amazon Music Unlimited afin d'accéder en illimité et à la demande à 100 millions de titres,

dont des millions en HD, Ultra HD et audio spatial ; enfin, chacun peut écouter de la musique

gratuitement en téléchargeant l'application Amazon Music ou via des appareils compatibles

avec Alexa. Rejoignez-nous pour contribuer à façonner la manière dont Amazon Music

interagit avec les fans, les artistes et les créateurs à l'échelle mondiale.

Nous recherchons un(e) Responsable de programme (Program Manager) maîtrisant le

français (langue maternelle ou niveau C2). Vous intégrerez notre équipe International

Product, responsable de l'expérience client dans les nombreux pays où Amazon Music est

présent. Vous contribuerez à améliorer le quotidien de nos clients francophones et à définir

les exigences linguistiques pour les nouvelles fonctionnalités d'Amazon Music qui améliorent

leur expérience musicale. Vos missions consisteront notamment à analyser et résoudre les

problèmes rencontrés par les clients, à identifier les lacunes de l'expérience client (CX) via

des audits de parcours et des workshops, à fournir un support produit et créer des rapports

personnalisés pour les parties prenantes internes et externes, ainsi qu'à accompagner nos

équipes mondiales Produit et QA (Assurance Qualité) pour tester l'expérience locale des

nouvelles fonctionnalités. Nous recherchons une personne à l'aise avec les données et les

produits technologiques pour prendre des décisions et proposer des améliorations de

l'expérience client, et qui s'épanouit dans un environnement dynamique et en évolution

rapide.

English

Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections

between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts,

concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting

intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our

different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music ad-free in shuffle mode,

and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to

Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including

millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading

the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence

how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.

We are looking for a Program Manager (m/f/d) with native / C2 level proficiency in French.

You will be part of our International Product Team that owns the customer experience in our

vast number of Amazon Music supported countries around the world. You will help us

improve the day-to-day experience of our French speaking customers and define language-

specific requirements for new Amazon Music features that make it easier for customers to

fall in love with music. Your focus will be to analyze and fix current customer issues, identify

CX gaps by conducting walk-the-store and workshops, provide product support to and create

customized reports for internal and external stakeholders, and support our global Product

and QA teams to test the local experience of brand-new features. We're looking for

someone who is comfortable working with data and technology products in order to make

decisions and suggest improvements to the CX, and thrives in a fast-paced and dynamic

environment.

Key job responsibilities

Français

Connaissance client : Vous adorez vous mettre à la place des clients, et êtes curieux(se) d'explorer les différentes manières dont ils consomment la musique. Vous tirez des enseignements des retours clients, des données d'utilisation et d'études externes, et alimentez la réflexion de nos chefs de produit grâce à des analyses ponctuelles ou des rapports hebdomadaires/mensuels sur l’expérience client.
Gestion des problèmes : Vous gérez simultanément de nombreuses demandes ponctuelles, tout en priorisant et en résolvant les lacunes de l'expérience client, qu'elles soient internes ou externes. Vous simplifiez des problèmes complexes, produisez des rapports personnalisés grâce à votre capacité à analyser les données, et communiquez efficacement avec les chefs de produit ainsi qu'avec les parties prenantes internes et

externes.

Soutien au lancement de fonctionnalités : Vous incarnez la voix locale du client pour les nouvelles expériences Amazon Music. Vous collaborez étroitement avec les équipes mondiales d'assurance qualité (QA) pour comprendre et vérifier l'expérience client locale. Vous communiquez vos conclusions de manière précise et orientée vers les solutions, tout en sachant trouver le juste équilibre entre rapidité d'exécution et obsession du client.
Soutien éditorial : Vous travaillez avec les équipes éditoriales, de programmation de contenu et de relations avec les labels pour garantir une expérience produit optimale lors de nos campagnes marketing et artistiques. Vous conseillez sur l'expérience visée, puis définissez et mettez en œuvre des solutions créatives pour ravir nos clients.
Benchmarking : Vous êtes l'expert(e) concernant l'expérience client du streaming musical local. Vous comparez notre produit à ceux d'autres fournisseurs internes et externes, et utilisez vos conclusions pour formuler des recommandations à nos chefs de produit.
Gestion des parties prenantes: Vous collaborez avec un large éventail d'interlocuteurs clés, notamment les chefs de produit locaux et mondiaux, le service client, les ingénieurs QA, le marketing, la programmation de contenu et les équipes chargées des relations

avec les artistes et les labels.

Gestion des processus : Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec d'autres chefs de programme et membres de l'équipe à l'élaboration de protocoles et de processus pour les mécanismes existants et futurs. Vous évaluez en permanence les outils et processus de collecte de données et proposez des solutions pour garantir leur efficacité, leur qualité et leur évolutivité.
Adoption de l'IA : Vous identifiez des opportunités d'utiliser des outils d'IA pour optimiser et automatiser des processus tels que l'analyse de l'expérience client, le reporting et le tri des problèmes, réduisant ainsi la charge de travail manuel tout en étendant la couverture géographique. Vous restez à l'affût des capacités émergentes de l'IA et formulez des recommandations concrètes pour améliorer l'efficacité de l'équipe grâce à ces technologies.

English

Customer Insights: You live and breathe customer insights, and are curious to explore the differences in how customers consume music. You derive insights from customer feedback, usage data, and external research, and provide input to our product managers through ad-hoc analyses or weekly/monthly CX reporting.
Issue Management: You manage numerous ad hoc requests concurrently, and prioritize and resolve internal and external customer experience gaps. You simplify complex issues, provide customized reporting with the ability to understand and analyze data, and effectively communicate to product managers, internal and external stakeholders.
Feature Launch Support: You are the local voice of the customer for new Amazon Music experiences. You work closely with global QA to understand and verify the local CX. You communicate findings in a precise and solution oriented manner and are able to walk the fine line between speed and customer obsession.
Editorial support: You work with editorial, content programming and label relations to enable a great product CX for our artist and marketing campaigns. You consult on the desired experience, and define and execute creative solutions to delight our customers. Benchmarking: You are the subject matter expert for the local music streaming CX. You benchmark our product against other internal and external providers, and use your findings to make recommendations to our product managers.
Stakeholder Management: You work with a broad set of key stakeholders including local and global product managers, customer service, quality assurance engineers, marketing, content programming and artist/label relations.
Process Management: You partner closely with other Program Managers and team members on protocol/process development for existing and future mechanisms. You continuously evaluate data collection tools and processes and offer solutions to ensure they are efficient, high quality and scalable.
AI Adoption: You identify opportunities to apply AI tools and automation to streamline processes such as CX analysis, reporting, and issue triage — reducing manual effort while scaling coverage across territories. You stay curious about emerging AI capabilities and bring practical recommendations for where they can improve team efficiency.

Basic Qualifications

Expérience en gestion de programmes ou de projets / Experience in program or project management
Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (oral et écrit) au niveau C2 ou supérieur / Speak, write, and read fluently in French and English at C2 level or above
Expérience dans la facilitation de la collaboration interne entre différentes équipes / Experience driving internal cross-team collaboration

Preferred Qualifications

Connaissance d’outils d'IA généralistes / Knowledge of general AI tools
Expérience dans des tâches ou projets analytiques impliquant le traitement de données / Experience in analytical tasks or projects, working with data
Expérience dans la définition et la mise en œuvre des exigences d'un programme / Experience defining and executing program requirements
Capacité avérée à travailler en autonomie au sein d'une équipe répartie géographiquement, en collaborant efficacement avec des parties prenantes situées sur différents sites et fuseaux horaires / Demonstrated ability to work autonomously within a distributed team, collaborating effectively with stakeholders across multiple locations and time zones
Expérience de travail avec des technologies et des produits numériques / Experience working with technology and digital products

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. Veuillez consulter notre Politique de Confidentialité pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous collectons, utilisons et traitons les données personnelles de nos candidats.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - Trucking Operations
jobs.description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About The Role

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive execution of Applied Intuition's global autonomous trucking programs. You will own the milestones our OEM customers are measured against, lead new operational launches - including standing up operations at new sites, lanes, and regions - and keep engineering, operations, and customer teams moving against a single plan.

This is a hands-on execution role. You will work daily with engineers at Applied Intuition and inside customer organizations, translating Level 4 (L4) autonomy deployment goals into schedules, dependencies, and decisions that hold up under pressure.

At Applied Intuition, You Will

Own program milestones end to end for strategic trucking engagements with global truck OEMs - building the integrated schedule, tracking dependencies across teams, and holding the organization to committed dates.
Lead new operational launches, including bringing up autonomous trucking operations at new sites and routes. You will build the launch plan and sequence work across facilities, fleet, safety, engineering, and local operations through to first revenue miles.
Surface and resolve risk early. Identify gaps before they become slips, drive blockers to resolution rather than escalate them, and make trade-offs visible to the people who need to decide.
Be the source of truth on program status for both working teams and executives - at Applied Intuition and at the customer. This means translating technical detail into decisions leadership can act on, not forwarding status decks.
Work directly with OEM customers and stakeholders to pin down use cases, clarify requirements, and unblock technical challenges across hardware, software, safety, and operations.
Implement operating practices that scale, so the second site launch is faster than the first and the tenth does not require you in the room.
Support business development by contributing to technical proposals and RFQ responses and hosting technology demonstrations for customer and executive audiences.

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

Bachelor's degree in a STEM field or equivalent experience.
5+ years of program or project management experience on advanced software, robotics, or autonomous vehicle programs (ADAS or L4 autonomy), including ownership of hard external deadlines.
Demonstrated ownership of a program launch or operational bring-up -a new site, facility, fleet, route, or region - from plan through steady state.
Track record running programs across distributed teams, sites, and time zones.
Ability to get deep into technical detail: enough systems-level understanding of hardware, software, and field operations to challenge a schedule you are handed rather than just publish it.
Communication skills that work in both directions - credible with engineers in a debug session and with OEM executives in a review.
Willingness to travel internationally to customer and operational sites.

Nice To Have

Direct experience on L4 autonomy programs, particularly trucking or long-haul freight.
Experience in commercial vehicle, logistics, or fleet operations.
Experience working directly with OEM or Tier 1 customers on joint development programs.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.title: Engineering Program Manager
jobs.description:
About The Company

Keurig Dr Pepper (Nasdaq: KDP) is a prominent leader in the global beverage industry, renowned for its extensive portfolio of over 150 owned, licensed, and partner brands. The company caters to a diverse range of consumer needs and occasions, establishing strong leadership positions across various segments including carbonated soft drinks, water, juice, and mixers. Its iconic brands such as Dr Pepper, Canada Dry, Mott's, A&W, Peñafiel, GHOST, 7UP, Snapple, Clamato, and Core Hydration are household names recognized for quality and innovation. Additionally, KDP’s global coffee division operates in more than 100 markets, featuring the popular Keurig single-serve brewing system alongside brands like Peet's, L'OR, and Jacobs. With a dedicated workforce of over 50,000 employees, KDP strives to enhance every beverage and coffee experience while making a positive impact on communities and the environment. The company is committed to fostering a culture of growth, innovation, and inclusivity, offering comprehensive benefits and development programs to support its team members.

About The Role

The Engineering Program Manager role at Keurig Dr Pepper is a strategic, leadership-focused position designed to oversee and drive capital projects across multiple manufacturing sites. This remote role requires approximately 50% travel, primarily within the US—specifically to the Northeast and West Coast operations—with limited international travel. Candidates based in the northeastern United States are preferred to facilitate collaboration and onsite engagement. As part of the Multisite Engineering team, the successful candidate will be responsible for developing and executing manufacturing engineering strategies that support the company's growth and productivity objectives. This includes managing capital projects for 6-8 non-carbonated soft drink and food manufacturing facilities, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget. The role involves building strong relationships with internal teams, external suppliers, and stakeholders to coordinate project execution, optimize equipment performance, and implement innovative solutions that enhance capacity and efficiency. The ideal candidate will have experience in managing large-scale manufacturing projects, particularly within the Food and Beverage or Consumer Packaged Goods sectors, with a solid understanding of high-speed filling, packaging equipment, and aseptic technologies. PMP certification, lean methodologies, and a proven track record in executing capital projects from conception through commissioning are essential.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Chemical Engineering.
Minimum of 8 years of experience managing capital engineering projects in a manufacturing environment.
Proven experience managing projects with budgets ranging from $100,000 to $25 million.
PMP certification or the ability to obtain certification within 12 months of employment.
Extensive knowledge of manufacturing technologies including carbonated soft drinks, juices, teas, aseptic processing, fillers, cappers, conveyance systems, packers, palletizers, control systems, reverse osmosis (RO), and Batch/CIP systems.
Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to travel overnight approximately 50% of the time, primarily within the US.
Ability to work independently in a remote setting with minimal supervision.

Responsibilities

Lead the design, development, and execution of capital projects from initial concept through to successful startup and commissioning, ensuring alignment with corporate goals.
Define project performance criteria, develop detailed project timelines, estimate capital budgets, and manage project expenditures effectively.
Make data-driven, methodical decisions that are critical to project success, utilizing key performance metrics and analysis.
Identify opportunities for cost savings and efficiency improvements across the manufacturing network, supporting overall business productivity targets.
Implement lean manufacturing principles and standard work practices to facilitate early equipment management and vertical startups.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with internal stakeholders, external equipment suppliers, and contractors to ensure project alignment and successful implementation—before, during, and after project completion.
Communicate effectively across diverse teams and levels within the organization, providing clarity and updates on project status, risks, and milestones.

Benefits

Competitive salary range of $96,800 to $150,000, commensurate with experience and skills.
Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage, disability insurance, and paid time off (including parental leave, vacation, and sick leave).
401(k) retirement plan with company match to support long-term financial planning.
Tuition reimbursement and mileage reimbursement programs to support personal and professional development.
Annual performance-based bonus opportunity.
Benefits are available from Day 1 of employment, emphasizing our commitment to employee well-being and satisfaction.

Equal Opportunity

Keurig Dr Pepper is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We recruit, hire, and promote qualified applicants and employees regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic by law. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances our innovation, performance, and community impact, and we are dedicated to providing an environment where all employees can thrive and grow.

jobs.description:
Location: Remote

Salary: 90k to 115K

We are seeking a highly analytical and forward-thinking Senior Procurement Analyst focused on BI and Data Analytics to support our Strategic Sourcing and Procurement team. This position is not a traditional procurement role, it's a key partner in delivering data-driven insights, improving visibility into spend and cost drivers, and enabling more effective sourcing decisions.

This position plays a critical role in building and scaling procurement analytics, tools, and data infrastructure—in some cases from the ground up. The analyst will help advance the organization’s procurement capabilities by improving reporting, standardizing data, and supporting the adoption of modern systems and technologies.

Working closely with the Strategic Sourcing and Procurement team, this role provides the analytical foundation, market insights, and reporting needed to support category and supplier strategies, while partnering with Finance to ensure accurate tracking and realization of cost changes.

Reasonable Accommodations Statement

To accomplish this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform, with or without reasonable accommodation, each essential function satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to help enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Key Responsibilities/Essential Functions

Analytics, Insights & Reporting

Provide data-driven insights and reporting to support sourcing decisions and financial planning

Analyze spend, volume, and supplier data across categories to improve cost visibility and support sourcing decisions
Translate demand and MRP data into clear insights, including impacts to spend, supplier capacity, and sourcing opportunities
Develop cost models and pricing analyses, including should-cost and total cost of ownership frameworks
Design and maintain dashboards and reporting for procurement KPIs
Partner closely with Finance to ensure accurate tracking, validation, and actualization of cost savings and cost changes
Support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis related to procurement initiatives
Develop clear, compelling presentations and slide decks, including executive updates, supplier QBRs, and sourcing insights

Data, Tools & Procurement Capability

Build and scale the data, systems, and capabilities that enable a best-in-class procurement function

Design and maintain data structures and reporting frameworks, including spend classification, supplier hierarchies, and KPI definitions
Develop solutions for data collection, cleansing, and analysis, including building datasets and tools where needed
Improve tools and systems, including defining requirements, improving usability, and driving adoption
Contribute to the procurement maturity roadmap and evaluate emerging technologies, including advanced analytics and AI-driven tools

Category & Sourcing Support

Enable Category Managers through data-driven insights, analysis, and performance visibility

Partner with Category Managers to deliver market research, inflation trends, key cost drivers (e.g., fish oil, resins, freight), and supplier insights that inform category and sourcing strategies
Track relevant indices and provide ongoing visibility into cost movements and market dynamics
Enable RFI/RFP processes, including improving and automating workflows where possible
Analyze and track supplier performance, developing KPIs and scorecards (cost, service, quality, reliability)
Contribute to development of supplier management and segmentation strategies (e.g., Kraljic matrix) based on performance, risk, and strategic importance
Track Procurement program progress and ensure visibility into realized vs. projected savings

Success in This Role Looks Like

Delivering clear insights that help Category Managers make better sourcing decisions
Building reliable reports and dashboards that improve visibility into spend, savings, and supplier performance
Creating clean, structured data and tools that reduce manual work and improve accuracy
Partnering with Finance to ensure cost savings and changes are accurately tracked
Identifying cost-saving opportunities and risks through data and market analysis
Communicating insights through clear, concise presentations that support decision-making

Required

Position Qualifications:

5+ years of experience in procurement, sourcing, supply chain, or analytics roles
Strong experience with spend analysis, cost modeling, and financial/data analysis
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with BI tools (Domo, Power BI, or similar)
Experience working with ERP or procurement systems (preference for SAP)
Ability to translate complex data into clear insights and executive-ready materials

Preferred

Experience building or improving data structures, reporting frameworks, or analytics capabilities
Experience partnering with Finance on cost tracking, budgeting, or savings validation
Familiarity with commodity markets, cost indices, or supply market analysis
Exposure to SQL, Python, or advanced analytics tools
Experience evaluating or implementing digital or AI-enabled procurement tools

Positive - Ability to view all situations with a positive attitude.
Accountable – takes ownership for responsibilities, acknowledges and learns from mistakes
Innovative - Ability to look beyond the standard solutions and "think outside the box".
Independent – Must be self-motivated and able to manage obligations without direct supervision

Enthusiastic - Ability to bring energy to the performance of a task.

The mission is personal. The systems protected deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are immediately at risk. The organization is the global leader in xOT cybersecurity, combining technology, threat intelligence, and expert services. The people here chose this work because they understand what is at stake. Here, you will find a remote-first mission-driven team across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC built on authenticity, transparency, and trust. If safeguarding the systems that protect your family, friends, and community is the kind of work that matters to you, you are in the right place.

About the Role

The company is seeking a Staff Business Operations Project Manager to join the Business Operations & Technology (BOT) team. This role owns day-to-day execution of senior-level operational projects that keep the organization running — spanning hardware and logistics, lab and infrastructure readiness, procurement and vendor management, and cross-departmental initiatives across IT, Security, Facilities, and Product & Engineering.

The Staff Business Operations Project Manager will work with limited direction, delivering high-complexity projects with meaningful business and financial impact. This individual will maintain comprehensive project plans and forecasts, manage risk across a varied operational portfolio, and give leadership consistent visibility into the status of various initiatives for cross-departmental efforts tied to the organization’s growth, including possible M&A-related integration work. The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between strategic planning and hands-on execution, and thrives in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

Key Responsibilities

Own execution of complex, senior-level operational projects spanning hardware and logistics, infrastructure readiness, procurement, vendor management, internal software migrations, and various strategic initiatives. Flexibility and willingness to work in ambiguity are required. Must be hands-on and able to drive and own execution, not just provide direction.
Aid in project management of global logistics operations, including international shipments, trade compliance, and lifecycle tracking for hardware deployed in the field, minimizing loss and improving asset recovery.
Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, roadmaps, and forecasts that reflect milestones and dependencies across the Business Operations portfolio. Enjoy working in a multi-disciplinary role across Product/Engineer/Operations.
Own sprint tracking and Agile ceremonies for active operational workstreams, ensuring consistent cadence and team accountability.
Lead issue resolution, change control, and risk mitigation independently, escalating only where cross-organizational alignment is required.
Build and maintain financial tracking, budget forecasts, and resource allocation reporting for large-scale operational initiatives.
Provide coaching and mentorship to associate and junior project managers supporting the operations portfolio.
Ensure project governance through consistent reporting, metrics, and adherence to PMO standards and policies.
Reduce single-point-of-failure risk by distributing execution responsibilities, managing risk, and maintaining clear, current status reporting and stakeholder visibility.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience managing IT or business operations projects in a production enterprise environment, with a demonstrated track record of delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives on time and within scope.
Strong proficiency with Agile/Scrum methodologies, including sprint planning, backlog management, and retrospective facilitation.
Experience managing projects using Jira, Confluence, and related Atlassian tools.
Proven ability to develop and maintain project plans, roadmaps, risk registers, and status reports that drive executive-level visibility.
Experience with hardware/asset logistics, PoC or demo equipment lifecycle management, or supply chain operations is preferred. International experience is a plus.
Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across technical and business domains without direct authority.
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate operational and financial details for non-technical stakeholders.
Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-changing environments, including supporting integration work tied to organizational growth or M&A activity.
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate dense regulatory and technical requirements for both technical and non-technical audiences. Focuses on solutions and strategy, not why something “can’t” be done.
PMP, PgMP, CSM, or SAFe certification is preferred.
Experience working in a cybersecurity, SaaS, or technology company is a plus; ICS/OT knowledge is nice to have.

About the Opportunity

The company is America’s fastest-growing meat snack brand, redefining convenient snacking with a commitment to real ingredients and bold, satisfying flavors. Crafted from 100% grass-fed, grass-finished beef and venison, along with antibiotic-free turkey and chicken, each meat stick delivers 10+ grams of high-quality protein without sugar, hormones, soy, dairy, artificial preservatives, artificial nitrates, or MSG. Seasoned with a blend of flavorful herbs and spices, the product provides a nutritious protein snack for the whole family. As a minority-owned, family-operated, and B Corporation-certified business, the organization prioritizes thoughtful sourcing and recently earned the non–ultra-processed food certification through the non-GMO project.

Traits of a Team Member

If you’ve been called scrappy, resourceful, and persistent, then you might just fit in. You’re a team player who’s self-motivated and action-oriented. You’re committed to delivering efficiency and accuracy, and you happen to be great at proactive cross-functional communication. You’re a critical thinker and a natural problem solver who enjoys details, research, and data. You take initiative and complete ownership of everything you do, and you’ll go the extra mile for your team, consumers, and audience. You’re hungry to learn with a passion to grow and improve every day. You also take a keen interest in health, fitness, and nutrition. Sound like you? Then the team wants to meet you.

What You Will Do

The Associate, Project Manager will support the planning, execution, and adoption of strategic digital transformation initiatives, including AI-driven capabilities, new software platforms, and process automation tools. Working under the direction of the Program Manager, this role assists across project coordination, change management, and training to help ensure seamless integration and lasting adoption across the organization.

You will help intake and organize digital transformation requests from functions across the organization and support the coordination of initiatives from concept through delivery. As a member of the Digital Transformation team, you will collaborate closely with these partners to help scope, prioritize, and execute initiatives that drive efficiency, enable data-driven decision-making, and support long-term innovation. This role offers a strong foundation for growing into broader program leadership, with increasing responsibility over time.

Responsibilities

Program & Project Management
Assist in tracking timelines, resources, budgets, and deliverables across multiple concurrent transformation projects.
Coordinate meetings, action items, and follow-ups to keep cross-functional teams aligned with business goals and strategic priorities.
Maintain detailed project documentation, task lists, risk logs, and status reports to support leadership visibility.
Change Management
Support the development and execution of change strategies, communication plans, and stakeholder engagement activities.
Help gather user feedback to identify adoption risks and resistance points, and assist in carrying out mitigation actions.
Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for end users, promoting a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.
Training & Enablement
Assist in designing and delivering training for AI tools, new systems, and digital workflows tailored to user roles and needs.
Create and maintain self-service resources, job aids, and interactive learning modules.
Support People Ops in embedding digital capabilities into onboarding and development programs.
Technology Integration
Coordinate with IT, Systems, BI, AI & Automation, and external vendors to support system integrations, tool deployments, and platform upgrades.
Help ensure smooth handover from project teams to operational owners, including documentation and support materials.
Track post-launch performance and user feedback to support continuous improvement.
Performance Tracking & Reporting
Help track KPIs and success metrics that measure adoption, efficiency gains, and business impact.
Prepare regular reports and dashboards for leadership and stakeholders.
Compile and organize data to support prioritization and future roadmap planning.
Governance & Standards
Support program governance processes, including intake, prioritization, and decision tracking.
Help ensure compliance with data privacy, security, and enterprise architecture standards.
Maintain alignment with the broader digital transformation strategy and enterprise goals.

Who You Are

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, or related field; CAPM, Agile, or Prosci certification is a plus.
3 – 5 years of experience in project coordination, project management, or a related role; internship or rotational experience considered.
Familiarity with change management principles and training concepts.
Exposure to AI tools, SaaS platforms, and process automation technologies.
Experience using project management software to organize work, track progress, and manage cross-functional tasks; Monday.com experience is a plus.
Strong communication, organizational, and time-management skills, with strong attention to detail.
Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, evolving environment, with a proactive eagerness to learn and grow.

Position
: Associate, Project Manager

Reports to
: Program Manager

: Full-Time, exempt

Salary Range Opportunity

The salary range for this role is $80,000 - $90,000
+ 15% annual bonus

Compensation Philosophy & Total Comp

The salary ranges are based on verified market data and the philosophy of paying competitively for the organization's size and industry.
Individual pay rate decisions are based on several factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.
In addition to base salary, full-time team members receive medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401K 6% match, and monthly reimbursements for wellness and home office.

Other Perks

Ability to make an impact: Join a rapidly growing and entrepreneurial-spirited team at a pivotal point to positively impact the food industry.
Opportunities to grow: Advance within the organization quickly based on outstanding performance.
Unlimited PTO and 15+ paid holiday days. Hybrid & flexible remote schedule. Chicago office open to those in the area.

Bi-annual total team in-person activities.
Company-wide Continual Education budget.

The organization is committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. To achieve its mission of making nutritious food more accessible, the organization greatly benefits from a range of perspectives, which comes from diversity of all types, at all levels of the organization. The organization is aware of the research showing that historically underrepresented groups are less likely to apply for a job if they don't believe that they meet all of the criteria.
