Bloomreach
builds agentic AI systems for our customers. We also run them ourselves.

Our AI SDR program books sales meetings with AI - inbound and outbound, across four regions, in multiple languages. The program needs an owner: someone who sets its direction, drives its results, and proves its ROI. This is a program leadership role, not an engineering one. Two dedicated AI ops experts build and run the platform. You decide what it does, why, and for whom. You should understand AI agents well enough to direct the people building them - your leverage is judgment, but being tech savvy is a must.

The team experiments by default: we test new AI tools, run scoped POCs, and keep what works. You'll own the program, its direction, its results, its pipeline number.

What You'll Own

The AI SDR program, end to end. Inbound and outbound, AMER + EMEA + APAC. Who gets enrolled, what the agents say, when a human takes over, and what it produces in pipeline. You set direction; the platform ops managers make it run. (Inbound request ops and routing sit with a colleague.)
Pipeline as your number, ROI as your story. Meetings booked → accepted → qualified pipeline created. Cost per meeting, cost per pipeline dollar. You report the program's return to leadership, with numbers that hold up under questioning.
The human SDR side. SDRs are the other half of the program - and where it most often breaks: lead quality disputes, unclear prioritization, follow-up that dies after one touch, handovers that lose context. You'll sit with the SDR teams and their leaders, find root causes, and fix them - with an AI assist, a process change, or a better definition.
The human–agent split. What agents do, what humans do, and where the handover sits. You own that line and move it based on evidence.
Signal-driven enrollment. Targeting runs on manual batches today. You'll drive the move to continuous enrollment based on account scoring, intent signals, and engagement decay. You define the logic; the ops team builds it.
The buying experience. Outreach should arrive because an account signalled something, say something true about the buyer's business, and make the next step obvious.
Program reporting. Volume, coverage, results, and ROI on a live dashboard, generated automatically. Parts still run on exports. Fix that early.
What comes next. The AI SDR pattern - signal in, agent acts, human closes - applies beyond outbound: event follow-up, hand-raiser nurture, re-engagement. Once the core program runs well, you'll make the case for the next one and drive its launch.

What success looks like after 3 months

Outbound volume and coverage are consistent across regions. Nobody asks "why did outbound drop last week?"
Leadership references your ROI model in planning: cost per meeting, cost per pipeline dollar, trend.
The top three SDR pain points from your first quarter are root-caused and fixed - and SDR leaders would confirm it unprompted.
Meeting acceptance is high. Rejections have known causes, not theories.
Reporting is fully automated. Your time goes into decisions.
The program activities and volume is connected to human activities, pipeline number for ICP accounts is bigger - and you can show which changes drove it.
At least one new agentic program is live and producing pipeline.

What you'll bring

You've run programs with a number attached. Demand gen, SDR/BDR, growth, or GTM programs where you owned the outcome and defended the metric.
You've operated AI workflows in production. You've deployed, directed, or owned automations other people depended on. You can set requirements, challenge the build, and tell when the agent is the problem versus the data. You don't need to write code - you do need to never be bluffed by it.
ROI fluency. You can build a cost-per-outcome model and explain it. You'd rather show a live dashboard than a slide.
You diagnose team problems at the source. "The leads are bad" is where your investigation starts, not where it ends. You've worked with frontline teams, found the real constraint, and fixed it.
SDRs, AEs, and their leaders are your users. When the program misfires, you’ll be their point of contact.
The buyer's point of view. Buyers don't care that outreach was efficient - only that it was worth their time. You'll kill a volume that doesn't clear that bar.
Enough technical depth to be dangerous. You can read a workflow, question a data model, and learn a new tool in a week. Experience with our stack is welcome, not required.
Global comfort. Four regions, several languages, overlap with US hours.

Big Advantage:: hands-on LLM tooling beyond vendor UIs (Claude Code, MCP, custom agents); time in or working with SDR/BDR and demand gen function in B2B SaaS.

The stack you'll drive

Salesforce

Qualified
Salesloft
UserGems
Claude - plus a mandate to evaluate AI-native tooling with a clear bar for measurable impact.

The team

You'll join Marketing Operations six people who operationalize and automate everything in marketing. Two of them work full-time on the AI SDR platform: they build and run it; you set its direction and co-own it: reporting and attribution, co-own and maintain inbound/outbound processes and find new tools. It's a team that builds its own tools rather than filing tickets for them.

More things you'll like about Bloomreach:

Culture:

A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one.
We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication.
We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style.
We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents.
We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead.
We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*.
The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5

Personal Development:

We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions.
Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.*
Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins.
Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)*

SOVOS

Enterprise Project Manager

Managed & Professional Services·Full-Time·UK/AMS/ESP

Build Your Future With Us

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.

The Role

At Sovos, we're transforming how global enterprises navigate regulatory complexity. We're looking for an Enterprise Project Manager to join our European Professional Services team, with the ability to be based in the United Kingdom, Netherlands, or Spain. This is a senior delivery role for an experienced PM who understands the complexity of enterprise SaaS implementations and brings deep familiarity with tax compliance, e-invoicing, or regulatory technology. You'll own end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-country implementations for enterprise clients across EMEA, operating with a high degree of autonomy and directly impacting client satisfaction and the reputation of Sovos Professional Services in Europe.

More Specifically, You Will

Own end-to-end project delivery for enterprise e-invoicing and tax compliance implementations across multiple EMEA countries simultaneously.
Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation for client stakeholders, from project teams to C-suite sponsors, throughout the engagement lifecycle.
Develop and maintain detailed project plans, risk registers, issue logs, and status reports; proactively surface risks and drive resolution before they become escalations.
Lead structured project governance, including weekly status meetings, monthly steering committee sessions, and go/no-go decision processes, in alignment with Sovos delivery methodology.
Manage project scope rigorously; identify, document, and drive change orders when client requests exceed agreed SOW boundaries.
Coordinate cross-functional Sovos resources (Solution Consultants, Technical Consultants, SAP specialists, Regulatory, and Product teams) to deliver against project commitments.
Track and report project hours against PS retainer balances; proactively communicate burn-down status and initiate retainer expansion conversations at appropriate thresholds.
Leverage AI-assisted project management tools to improve delivery efficiency, automate status reporting, and surface risk patterns across the client portfolio.
Manage Hypercare periods post-go-live and execute formal project handover to Sovos Customer Support.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of PS delivery methodology, SOW templates, onboarding playbooks, and project governance frameworks.

What You Bring to Sovos

You've built solid experience delivering enterprise SaaS implementations in a client-facing Professional Services environment, with demonstrated expertise managing complex, multi-stakeholder implementations in the tax compliance, e-invoicing, VAT, or regulatory technology space.
Demonstrated success managing projects with enterprise clients (500M+ revenue) across multiple countries and time zones concurrently.
Experience with SAP-integrated implementations (SAP ECC, S/4HANA, or Process Orchestration) is strongly preferred.
Hands-on experience with retainer-based PS engagements, including scope management, change order discipline, and hour burn-down governance.
Familiarity with EMEA e-invoicing mandates, including France (PPF/PDP), Germany (XRechnung/Peppol), Poland (KSeF), and/or Turkey (e-Fatura/e-Arşiv), is a significant advantage.
Exceptional stakeholder management skills: able to build trust with client executives and navigate competing priorities without losing delivery momentum.
Solid commercial acumen: you understand the relationship between project delivery, revenue recognition, and margin, and manage accordingly.
Proactive risk management mindset: you identify and escalate issues early, document decisions, and drive accountability without being asked.
Clear, structured communicator (written and verbal) capable of adapting tone and detail level for technical teams, client project managers, and executive sponsors alike.
Comfortable operating with ambiguity and driving clarity in fast-moving, multi-mandate environments where priorities can shift quickly.
Proficiency with project management tooling (e.g. Cloud Coach, Salesforce, Jira, or equivalent PSA/CRM platforms); comfort with AI-assisted workflows to enhance delivery speed and insight generation is a plus.
Demonstrated project management capability through certifications (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) or equivalent proven delivery experience is valued.
Equivalent experience to a Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field.
Fluency in English required; proficiency in French, German, Dutch, Spanish, or Polish is a meaningful advantage given the client base.
Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:

1

Pre-Employment Assessment

Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.

2

Video Interview

A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.

3

Meeting with a Recruiter

A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals.

4

Live Interviews with the Hiring Team

Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role.

Life at Sovos

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

Global Mentoring Programs
AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
Continuous Learning and Development
Language Learning Support
Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
Global Parental Leave Policy
30 days holiday plus bank holidays
Private Health Insurance

Vision Coverage

Income Protection
Pension with employer contribution

We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries.

More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com.

Job Description

Ryan Companies US, Inc. has an exciting career opportunity for a Commissioning Program Manager to join our National Mission Critical team!

The Commissioning Program Manager is responsible for leading and coordinating the commissioning program across multiple construction projects for a single client. This role establishes and maintains commissioning standards, oversees project execution, and supports field teams to ensure building systems are planned, installed, tested, and documented in accordance with performance, quality, and safety requirements. The Commissioning Program Manager serves as a key liaison between internal stakeholders, design teams, subcontractors, and owners to drive successful handover of high-performing facilities.

Some Things You Can Expect To Do

Program Leadership & Strategy

Develop and maintain company-wide commissioning procedures, standards, and best practices.
Manage commissioning project delivery strategies across all applicable project sites.
Develop, implement, and ensure project participation in the company commissioning program and processes.
Refine commissioning practices and policies used in the field and develop methods/techniques for driving issues to resolution.
Regularly review commissioning progress, risks, issues, and KPI metrics across active projects and report to management.
Support hiring efforts for commissioning managers and personnel as needed.
Assist in staffing and resource allocation planning for commissioning across multiple projects.

Team Leadership & Guidance

Lead, mentor, and performance-manage a team of commissioning professionals.
Provide training and guidance to field teams on commissioning sequencing, durations, and expectations.
Coordinate and, when needed, lead commissioning kickoff meetings to describe commissioning objectives and requirements to equipment vendors, subcontractors, and owner representatives.
Promote a culture of safety, quality, and accountability within the commissioning team.
Role should expect to have up to 8 direct reports.

Project Coordination & Support

Review design documents to understand and communicate system performance requirements for each project.
Ensure project commissioning teams are aware of and aligned with design intent and performance criteria.
Attend key owner/architect/contractor (OAC), commissioning, and coordination meetings as required.
Manage high-level coordination and issue resolution with clients, vendors, and other stakeholders when critical commissioning issues arise.
Provide project teams with guidance on commissioning schedule integration, issue tracking and closure, client communications, and general commissioning management.

Field Oversight & Execution

Ensure field inspections, functional testing, and documentation support the successful execution of the quality and commissioning program.
Collaborate with project teams to monitor progress of commissioning activities and ensure alignment with project milestones.
Provide on-site support at active projects as required to troubleshoot issues and support successful commissioning execution.

Continuous Improvement & Knowledge Sharing

Implement and maintain commissioning KPIs and continuous improvement processes to prevent repeat deficiencies and minimize impacts to project schedules.
Capture, document, and communicate lessons learned across projects to improve future commissioning efforts.
Contribute to the development of training materials, tools, and templates that support consistent commissioning delivery.

Job Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, building systems, or related field; or equivalent experience.
10+ years of experience in commercial construction, MEP systems, or related technical field including 5+ years of experience in data center commissioning; multi-project or program-level experience preferred.
Strong understanding of building systems (mechanical, electrical, plumbing, controls, and life safety).
Proven experience leading commissioning activities on complex or large-scale projects.
Experience coordinating with owners, design teams, contractors, and vendors in a construction environment.

Have earned professional certifications related to commissioning, building systems, or project management (e.g., CxA, CEM, PE, PMP).

Position Description

Join us in shaping Seattle’s streets!

At the Seattle Department of Transportation (SDOT), we don’t just move people—we connect communities, build safer streets, and create a more sustainable city.

With a bold vision for the future, we’re tackling big challenges: making travel safer, cutting carbon emissions, and ensuring reliable, affordable transportation for everyone—no matter who they are or where they live.

Seattle is growing fast, and we’re growing with it. Thanks to a historic voter-approved $1.55 billion investment in transportation in 2024, we’re building sidewalks, fixing bridges, and improving transit connections to keep our city moving.

We’re a team of problem solvers, planners, engineers, communicators, and field crews—bringing purpose-driven work to life. Now, we need passionate, innovative talent like you. Let’s build a Seattle that works for everyone—together!

Position Overview

This Program Manager (under the City's classification title of Manager 2- Information Technology) leads SDOT’s Asset & Performance Management portfolio within the Technology & Innovation team. The role is accountable for strategy, people leadership, and delivery of enterprise asset management capabilities across SDOT. Responsibilities include driving system modernization, advancing asset data stewardship, embedding lifecycle cost analysis and risk-based decision-making, and ensuring integration with GIS and analytics to produce transparent, actionable performance insights for executives, City Council, and the public. The position reports to the Data & GIS Manager.

Job Responsibilities

Lead Enterprise Asset and Work Order Management modernization from planning through stabilization. Responsibilities include requirements management, vendor oversight, and coordination of configuration, testing, migration, change management, training, go-live, and post go-live optimization with business stakeholders.
Own enterprise asset data governance. Establish authoritative inventories, condition assessment standards, asset hierarchy, data dictionaries, QA and QC controls, and ongoing maintenance processes.
Integrate asset systems with ESRI GIS and analytics. Enable spatial analysis, dashboards, and operational decision support for maintenance, capital planning, and performance reporting.
Advance lifecycle plans and deterioration models for high value assets. Standardize Levels of Service targets and incorporate triple bottom line considerations in investment decisions.
Direct enterprise performance reporting. Deliver required updates and reports to external stakeholders and internal leadership.
Chair and coordinate governance forums including the APMSC, the Asset Maintainers Data User Group, GIS workplan, and data governance meetings. Ensure timely decisions and cross-division alignment.
Manage and mentor the Asset and Performance Management team including analysts, economists, and advisors. Set goals, develop staff, and recruit to fill critical skill gaps.
Represent Asset and Performance Management in interactions with other SDOT divisions. Prepare executive briefings and recommendations for budget, capital planning, and technology investments.
Champion our goals around diversity, equity and social justice

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, public administration, business, information systems, or a related field.
Seven (7) or more years of progressively responsible asset management leadership in a public-sector or large infrastructure organization.
Two (2) or more years of supervisory or management experience.

OR
A combination of education and/or training and/or experience, which provides an equivalent background required to perform the work of the class.

Successful candidates will possess many of these additional qualifications or be able to demonstrate comparable experience and expertise:

Demonstrated success leading an enterprise asset and/or work order system implementation from vendor selection through adoption, including data governance and change management.
Experience integrating asset systems with ESRI ArcGIS and/or analytics platforms. Strong understanding of lifecycle costing and risk-based decision frameworks.
Professional credentials such as IAM, PMP, or Prosci.
Direct experience with municipal asset portfolios including pavements, bridges, signals, and sidewalks, and transit asset management processes.
Hands-on expertise with enterprise asset management and/or EAWOMS platforms such as Infor, IBM Maximo, or Trimble Unity.
Familiarity with StreetSaver and/or BridgeWorks and their integrations to ESRI ArcGIS.
Proven ability to lead data stewardship initiatives and deliver public facing performance dashboards and reports.
Experience aligning investments to equity and/or climate outcomes using structured performance frameworks.
Thrive in a multi-cultural workplace and serve a diverse customer base with professionalism and inclusivity.

Work Environment/Physical Demands

Work is performed in an office environments with hybrid options at this time.
The position requires sitting or standing for extended periods and occasional lifting of up to 25 pounds.

Additional Information

Please attach both a cover letter and resume to your application.

Failure to do so will result in your application not being considered.

Offers of employment are contingent on verification of information provided by the applicant as part of the application process, including background check.

This hiring process involves a background check of conviction and arrest records in compliance with Seattle's Fair Chance Employment Ordinance, SMC 14.17. Applicants will be provided with an opportunity to explain or correct background information.

This position is open to all candidates that meet the minimum qualifications. The City of Seattle values diverse perspectives and life experiences. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related technical field.

Strong understanding of LLM architecture, frameworks (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face), and model evaluation.

Experience directing programs related to AI/ML development, model evaluation, agentic safety, security, content safety, hallucinations, and/or production releases.
Familiarity with AI safety risks such as hallucinations, timely injection attacks, unsafe tool use, data poisoning, model manipulation, and unintended agent behavior.
Experience supporting model-safety evaluations, Red Teaming, adversarial testing, security assessments, or responsible-AI programs.

Experience with LLM Agentic Safety, Security, Red Teaming, Hallucinations, adversarial assessment, or Responsible AI.
Experience defining evaluation datasets, rubrics, benchmarks, and release gates.
Ability to use evaluation results and data to make clear release recommendations and communicate residual risk to leadership.
Experience crafting or operationalizing multi-turn, hallucination, adversarial, or agentic-safety evaluations.

Our purpose – Opening up a world of opportunity – explains why we exist. Here at HSBC we use our unique expertise, capabilities, breadth and perspectives to open up new kinds of opportunity for our more than 40 million customers. We’re bringing together the people, ideas and capital that nurture progress and growth, helping to create a better world – for our customers, our people, our investors, our communities and the planet we all share.

In compliance with applicable laws, HSBC is committed to employing only those who are authorized to work in the US. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. as HSBC will not engage in immigration sponsorship for this position.

At HSBC, we value difference and succeed together. We’re seeking a dynamic Senior Project Manager to join our Client Change Management team, part of Client Connectivity within Global Payment Systems. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of technology and business, and is passionate about delivering seamless, innovative solutions for our diverse U.S. and global clients. You’ll lead the full project life cycle for new products, services, and systems, collaborating with stakeholders across business and technology to continually enhance the client experience. This is a high-impact role, working on complex cross-border projects with both internal and external stakeholders.

As Our Senior Project Manager, Client Connectivity You Will

Lead end-to-end delivery of client change initiatives, including planning, execution, risk management, and issue resolution
Collaborate with business units and clients to gather requirements, define project scope, and set clear deliverables
Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, and status reports, communicating progress to clients, stakeholders, and senior sponsors
Conduct user training sessions and prepare supporting documentation to support adoption and client satisfaction
Oversee the setup and onboarding of new financial products and connectivity solutions for clients
Coordinate with global and U.S. based teams as the central point of contact to ensure deliverables are met
Design and execute system integration strategies with internal systems and third-party platforms (e.g., SWIFT, ISO 20022, APIs, host-to-host)
Manage testing of payment and receivables files in industry-accepted formats, coordinating globally as required
Ensure data integrity, security, and compliance throughout implementation, adhering to U.S. regulatory requirements

You´ll likely have the following qualifications to succeed in this role:

Proven experience in systems implementation and integration, preferably within the financial services sector
Strong project management skills with a track record of delivering projects on time and within scope
Project management certification (e.g., PMP, Prince2, Agile) is advantageous but not required
Technical proficiency in integration tools, APIs, and data mapping; familiarity with platforms such as JIRA, MS Project, or Confluence is a plus
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing abilities, including experience working with senior leaders
Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving and process optimization skills
Familiarity with U.S. compliance, data privacy, and security best practices
Experience working in a multicultural, global environment is highly valued
Attention to detail, coupled with a strategic, big-picture perspective

As an HSBC employee, you will have access to tailored professional development opportunities to ensure you have the right skills for today and tomorrow. We offer a competitive pay and benefits package including a robust Wellness Hub, all in a welcoming and inclusive work environment. You will be empowered to drive HSBC’s engagement with the communities we serve through an industry-leading volunteerism policy, a generous matching gift program, and a comprehensive program of immersive Sustainability and Climate Change Initiatives. You’ll want to join our Employee Resource Groups as they play a central part in life at HSBC, including the development of our employees and networking inside and outside of HSBC. We value difference. We succeed together. We take responsibility. We get it done. And we want you to help us build the bank of the future!

The final fixed pay offer will depend on the candidate and several variables, including but not limited to, role responsibilities, skill set, depth of experience and education, licensing/certification requirements, internal relativity, and specific work location.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, race, national origin, ethnicity, disability or medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran service, religion, creed, sex, gender, pregnancy, childbirth, caregiver status, marital status, citizenship or immigration status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression or any other trait protected by applicable law.

new_jobs.title: Security Manager UK&I
new_jobs.description:
About the Role:

At Ferrero, protecting our people, our brands and our business is fundamental to how we operate.

As Security Manager UK&I, you will lead the development, implementation and continuous improvement of our security strategy across the UK and Ireland, working closely with Group Security and senior stakeholders across the business. With a remit spanning our manufacturing sites, offices, warehouses, Head Office and wider business operations, this is a broad and influential security leadership role.

Taking a holistic and risk-based approach, you will be responsible for helping protect our people, physical assets, goods, critical processes and organisational know-how, balancing effective risk mitigation with commercial awareness and operational practicality.

This is much more than a traditional site security role. Your remit will span security intelligence, physical and logistical security, executive protection, travel security, incident and crisis management, investigations, due diligence, security training, and threat and risk assessment.

As a trusted adviser to UK&I leadership, you will assess an evolving risk landscape, ensure emerging threats and vulnerabilities are understood and appropriately escalated, and translate complex security risks into proportionate, practical solutions for the business.

Main Responsibilities:

You will lead the implementation and continuous improvement of Ferrero's Security Management System across UK&I, ensuring alignment with Group standards while responding to the specific risk profile and operational requirements of the local business.

You will develop and maintain security, emergency response and crisis management plans, alongside programmes covering physical security, information protection, incident management, travel security and executive protection.

A key part of your role will be monitoring and assessing the external threat landscape, including crime, terrorism, workplace violence, geopolitical and travel risks, natural or man-made disruption and emerging security threats, translating intelligence into appropriate action for the business.

You will lead and support sensitive internal investigations involving matters such as theft, fraud, conflicts of interest, bribery, loss of assets and unauthorised disclosure of proprietary information, working with relevant internal functions and external authorities where appropriate.

You will oversee physical security projects from initial risk assessment and technical requirements through to implementation, coordinating internal stakeholders, suppliers and contractors and ensuring effective management of scope, timelines, budgets and delivery.

Working closely with Supply Chain, you will support an effective logistics security programme designed to protect raw materials and finished goods across domestic and international movements.

You will manage UK&I security CAPEX and OPEX budgets
, including forecasting, cost control and variance management, ensuring investment decisions remain aligned with identified risks and business priorities.

Building strong relationships will be fundamental to the role. You will partner with UK&I leadership, Plant Management, Supply Chain, P&O, Risk Management, Finance and Group Security, while also maintaining appropriate external networks with law enforcement, intelligence and security organisations.

You will also lead security awareness and training initiatives, strengthening security capability across the organisation and ensuring our people understand the role they play in protecting themselves, their colleagues and the business.

About You:

You will be an established security professional with experience operating across a complex corporate, multi-site or similarly demanding environment, bringing the credibility and judgement required to influence at senior level.

You will have strong knowledge across areas including corporate and physical security, threat and risk assessment, investigations, crisis and incident management, and security intelligence, with the ability to understand how different areas of security risk connect across an organisation.

Comfortable moving between strategy and execution, you will be equally confident advising senior leaders on significant or emerging risks and ensuring security programmes, controls and projects are successfully delivered operationally.

You will bring strong judgement, integrity and discretion when handling confidential or sensitive matters, alongside the ability to remain calm, assess information quickly and make sound decisions in complex or rapidly developing situations.

Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills are essential, together with the ability to build effective relationships across different functions, locations and levels of seniority.

You will also bring strong project and financial management capability, ideally including experience managing security suppliers, significant physical security projects and CAPEX/OPEX budgets.

If you are a security leader who combines strong technical expertise with commercial judgement, stakeholder influence and the ability to turn risk insight into action, this is an opportunity to shape security capability and resilience across Ferrero UK&I and help us continue to protect what matters most – our people, our business and our brands.

What We Offer:

Careers with caring built in - discover our benefits here.

About Ferrero:

Ferrero began its journey in the small town of Alba in Piedmont, Italy, in 1946.
Today, it is one of the world’s largest sweet-packaged food companies, with many iconic brands
sold in countries all over the world. Find out more about Ferrero at ferrero.com.

DE&I at Ferrero:

Ferrero is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which all employees feel welcomed and appreciated and have the same opportunities. We believe all our people are equally talented in their own way. In nurturing the curiosity and natural abilities of our employees, we provide them, generation after generation, the means to succeed personally and professionally, enabling them to craft their journey at Ferrero. The diversity of our talents is what makes our work environment multicultural, innovative, and highly rewarding.

Job Overview

We are seeking a project manager (PM) for work supporting the Defense Intelligence Agency Directorate of Intelligence Analysis (DIA/DI) Certified Defense All-Source Analysis (CDASA) Professional Certification Program.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate traits that align with PatchPlus’ guiding principles – Purpose, Proficiency, and Character. PatchPlus’ purpose is to continue to make a difference to our nation’s security while providing persistent, meaningful employment to its owner-employees. Proficiency defines the PatchPlus ethos where we seek to hire and develop members who possess a high degree of competence, skill and expertise in their field of work. Character is the moral compass in each member that guides us to do the right things.

Responsibilities / Duties

Participate in job task analyses for defense all-source analysts (ASA).
Planning, executing, and delivering projects successfully while managing teams, resources, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables.
Create detailed project plans, establish timelines, and secure approvals from stakeholders to ensure projects are viable and aligned with organizational goals.
Assemble and lead project teams, assign tasks, and ensure effective collaboration.
Motivate team members, resolve conflicts, and maintain alignment with project goals.
Lead accreditation efforts.
Support administration for all Program Management Office (PMO) functions, to include candidate and certificant support, program policy, procedure, and other document development, and certificant tracking.
Coordinate exam delivery with DIA Academy for Defense Intelligence (ADI) and/or DIA Directorate for Intelligence Analysis (DIA/DI) instructors.
Support the development of accreditation packages to the National Commission for Certifying Agencies.

Requirements

TS/SCI clearance with ability to pass a counterintelligence (CI) scope polygraph.
Five (5) years of experience in program management, project management, or a related field.
Expert knowledge of DoD processes and terminology
Expert MS Office skills demonstrated through creation of a variety of published products.
Successful experience engaging senior level (general officer / flag officer / senior executive service / Under Secretary) professionals, facilitating meetings at that level, and developing their decision briefs.
Strong attention to detail and communication skills demonstrated through development of products requiring senior-level signature for release, passing inspector general review, or successful professional certification accreditation.

Preferred Qualifications

Active CDASA-I (CDASA) certification.
Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Management, or a related field.
Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Agile certification, Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification, or demonstrable equivalent experience.
Three (3) years of experience collaborating in multi-agency or joint efforts that require the use of written and oral communication skills that display the ability to tailor ideas, explanations, presentations, briefings, and concepts to suit any audience and any purpose with skill at facilitating meetings.
Three (3) years of experience with data analysis and reporting tools, such as (but not limited to) Tableau.
Three (3) years of experience in supporting intelligence training and/or education. programs, processes, or systems with exposure to missions, functions, policies, authorities and requirements for both civilian and military components relating to intelligence training and/or education.
Two (2) years of experience with nationally accredited Certification Program development and technical/program documentation that meet NCCA or equivalent standards for accreditation of certification programs and prevailing professional guidelines and standards.
Three (3) years of experience developing and implementing standards to accomplish program goals that require the ability to conduct in-depth qualitative analysis according to set categories and defined business processes.
Five(5) years operational experience as an all-source intelligence analyst as demonstrated by successful assignments in an ICD 203-related billet.
Experience running the administration of a certification program, preferably a program accredited by the National Commission for Certifying Agencies (NCCA).
Familiarity with DoD instructional systems design (ISD) processes and/or project management of the same.
Familiarity with supporting job task analyses (JTAs) to understand the critical tasks related to the performance of a job and translating the technical information in a way that supports the development of a wide range of human capital products (e.g., learning objectives, certifications standards, position descriptions, job qualification checklists).

new_jobs.title: ODM Business Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

We are seeking a diligent and analytical ODM Business Operations Manager to join NVIDIA’s Data Center organization — the team constructing the world’s AI factories. In this position, you will assist in developing how NVIDIA partners with the globe’s top manufacturing collaborators to bring forth next-generation AI infrastructure. You’ll be a member of a fast-paced, data-driven team that merges engineering, operations, and finance into one execution engine. We appreciate individuals who transform data into insight, insight into action, and action into measurable outcomes. In this role, you will collaborate with top ODMs and NVIDIA teams to build scalable processes, efficient operations, and data-driven insights for the AI supply chain.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead business operations and analytics across NVIDIA’s ODM ecosystem, enabling manufacturing scalability and operational rigor.
Develop and maintain data-driven operational models and dashboards to track capacity, yield, and shipment performance across partners.
Partner with Finance, Operations, WWFO, and Product teams to connect operational metrics with financial outcomes.
Implement governance frameworks, standardized important metrics, and regular reviews to develop accountability and transparency across global sites.
Collaborate with ODMs and internal teams to boost data accuracy, efficiency visibility, and process automation.

What We Need To See

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Business, or Finance or equivalent experience (MBA preferred).
12+ years of experience in hardware operations, manufacturing analytics, or financial planning — ideally within data center, semiconductor, or hyperscaler environments.
Proven strength in data analysis, modeling, and visualization using tools including Tableau and Microsoft Office.

Are you ready to build the future of supply chain? Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS) is the next AWS — a high-growth business that is opening Amazon's world-class logistics infrastructure to companies of all sizes. This is a unique opportunity to join one of Amazon's fastest-growing external-facing businesses at a pivotal inflection point — where the operational excellence we've built over decades becomes a platform for millions of sellers, brands, and merchants worldwide.

This role will drive the end-to-end onboarding experience for shippers joining our network — ensuring a frustration-free path from sign-up to first package inducted across our rapidly scaling shipper base. The successful candidate will be a strategic thinker with strong communication and collaboration skills, adept at identifying friction points, influencing cross-functional product teams, and ensuring shippers realize the full value of Amazon's logistics capabilities from day one. You'll operate at the intersection of product, operations, and customer experience — partnering across teams to help enterprise and mid-market shippers successfully launch and scale with Amazon Shipping.

Relentlessly advocate for shippers and strive to simplify and improve their onboarding experience.

Work closely with operations teams on process improvements that enhance the shipper onboarding experience.

Support and drive process improvement workstreams to improve lead-to-launch conversion rate and time-to-launch across the pipeline.

Help scale services, tools, and processes that enable the business' growth in volume, complexity, and geographic reach while maintaining a high bar for the customer experience.

Develop clear and thorough program/process launch announcements for impacted internal and external stakeholders, including program announcements, FAQs, and program resource guides.

Travel up to 20% of the time.

Day-to-day, you will be focused on operationalizing new shippers onto the Amazon Shipping network — bridging the gap between onboarding and operations to ensure a seamless launch experience. Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team

Experience working with a ticket management system to collect, document and maintain information pertinent to security investigations and incidents; experienced in monitoring the operational status of monitoring components and escalating and reporting outages of the components; have working knowledge of the various operating systems (e.g. Windows, OS X, Linux, etc.) commonly deployed in enterprise networks.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager II, Buyer Abuse
new_jobs.description:
Description

Amazon's Buyer Abuse Prevention (BAP) team sits within the broader Buyer Risk Prevention (BRP) organization — a centralized technology and program team whose mission is to make Amazon the safest and most trusted place worldwide to transact online. Buyer abuse is defined as the risk associated with customers repeatedly violating Amazon's policies and affecting the profitability, brand, and reputation of Amazon or its Selling Partners.

BAP sits at the intersection of technology, policy, and operations to detect, investigate, and prevent abusive behaviors across Amazon. Our work directly impacts Amazon's bottom line, protecting hundreds of millions of dollars in concession losses annually while preserving the customer and seller experience.

BAP is seeking an innovative, results-oriented, and customer-centric Program Manager to own and drive the Automation program across the Buyer Abuse Prevention organization. In this role, you will be responsible for scaling Amazon's ability to investigate and act on risky orders and concessions at billions-of-transactions scale — without relying on manual effort. You will define the automation strategy, manage a portfolio of automation initiatives, and balance the dual mandate of maximizing automation rate while carefully managing enforcement quality through leakage (under-enforcement) and customer experience (over-enforcement) metrics.

The successful candidate will be highly analytical, resourceful, customer focused, team oriented, and have an ability to work independently under time constraints to meet deadlines. He or she will have a proven track record in taking on end-to-end ownership and successfully delivering results in a fast-paced and dynamic business environment.

Key job responsibilities

Own the end-to-end Automation program strategy, roadmap, and execution across BAP, including setting goals, success metrics, and mechanisms to track progress against automation rate targets.
Balance the core automation tradeoff: maximizing automation rate while managing leakage (under-enforcement risk) and customer experience metrics (over-enforcement risk), ensuring precision thresholds are maintained across all deployed models and workflows.
Define and manage key success metrics for the Automation program, including automation rate, task coverage, precision, leakage rate, false positive rate, and customer-facing impact metrics.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, and Data Science teams to design, test, and launch new automation capabilities — including LLM-powered enforcement, model-based auto-decisions, and workflow automation.
Interact with key stakeholders to define the metrics, measurements, and tools to quantify automation program goals and communicate results to Senior Leaders across Amazon.
Conduct in-depth reviews of automation performance data to identify patterns, gaps, and opportunities; develop reports and narratives for leadership and partner teams.
Communicate (both verbally and in writing) program successes, failures, lessons learned, and mitigation plans to stakeholders.
Champion on behalf of Amazon and our Customers and help uncover issues currently impacting our Customer Experience as a result of automation decisions.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of program or project management experience
3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
3+ years of driving process improvements experience
Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

new_jobs.description:
At Equitable, we believe work should be a place where you feel supported, inspired, and empowered to grow. In our caring and collaborative environment, your curiosity is encouraged, your passion is recognized, and your contributions truly matter. Together, we create meaningful impact, for our clients, our communities, and each other.

The Opportunity:
At Equitable, we realize that your work is not just about performing a job; it's about being part of a collaborative workplace that helps you grow and reach your full potential. Within our friendly and collaborative work environment, we recognize that they key to our growth and success is a dedicated, motivated, and client-responsive staff. Join Equitable today!

Reporting to the Portfolio Director, the Senior Project Manager’s role is to plan and coordinate the implementation of solutions that deliver to business strategic objectives. This individual will partner with the Individual Leadership Team (ILT) to identify, plan and execute solutions that will support the achievement of annual business plans. This position acts as a liaison between ILT, Business Stakeholders, technical delivery teams and external vendors to effectively plan, resource and deliver key divisional strategic initiatives.

Don’t miss the opportunity to join one of Waterloo Area and Southwestern Ontario's Top Employers!

Work Arrangements:
This is a hybrid role. You will work in our office in Waterloo, ON a minimum of two (2) assigned, consecutive days every other week, plus a fifth (5th) assigned day per month. You are welcome to work from the office more than the minimum requirement, and there may be some roles that are required to work in our office more than the minimum requirement.

What you’ll do:

Build strong working relationships with project decision-makers, managers, business stakeholders, and cross-functional team members.
Partner with stakeholders to define business deliverables and formalize project requirements into actionable project plans.
Coordinate business deliverables and timelines with Product Owners and Technology Managers to support the successful delivery of key initiatives.
Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget while aligning with business objectives.
Identify, manage, and communicate project dependencies, inter-project impacts, resource constraints, and portfolio risks.
Support alignment of project activities with Individual Insurance strategic priorities and annual business plans.
Lead organizational change management activities, including stakeholder engagement, communication planning, business readiness, training coordination, and adoption planning.
Facilitate meetings, foster collaboration, and resolve conflicts among stakeholders to maintain project momentum and drive results.
Prepare feasibility studies and cost-benefit analyses while providing guidance to ILT members completing similar assessments.
Develop and deliver regular progress reports and updates to Individual division business leaders on key strategic initiatives.

What you’ll bring:

University degree with a minimum Bachelor's degree.
Obtained, or currently working toward, PMP certification.
Minimum 5 years of industry experience, including a strong understanding of insurance products and systems.
Project management and project planning experience, with knowledge of current project management methodologies.
Strong understanding of process management and process improvement methodologies.
Experience with Agile and Lean methodologies is considered an asset.
Excellent relationship-building skills and the ability to work effectively with individuals at all levels of the organization.
Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
Exceptional negotiation, influencing, communication, and facilitation skills.
Superb organizational skills, along with experience in conflict management and stakeholder engagement.

What’s in it for you:

Career Growth: Regular learning sessions and development opportunities
Total Rewards: Incentive pay, annual salary reviews, employer-paid benefits and pension matching
Time Away: Competitive vacation plus one paid volunteer day each year
Flexibility: Healthy work-life balance with employee wellness always top of mind, complemented by a “dress for your day” approach

At Equitable, we’re committed to fair pay and an inclusive, accessible hiring experience. If you need accommodations or alternative formats at any stage, just reach out to us at careers@equitable.ca. We’re happy to help.

Your base pay will be based on your skills, qualifications, experience and education. In addition to your salary, this role is eligible for a discretionary annual incentive award tied to business performance, plus a wide range of competitive benefits.

If you’re selected to move forward, our Talent Acquisition team will walk you through all the details of our total rewards program, so you know exactly what’s included.

new_jobs.title: Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
We are seeking motivated Business Analysts to join our Frontline Operations group.

As a member of Frontline Operations, you’ll lead and support the delivery of high-quality services, ensuring the integrity of Australia’s tax and superannuation systems.

As a Business Analyst in our Frontline Business Improvement, Frontline Risk and Strategy and Frontline Resource Management business areas, you will apply your technical expertise and business knowledge to engage stakeholders, gather and analyse requirements, and support the design and implementation of business solutions that align with business objectives.

You will translate information and data from a range of sources into meaningful insights, recommendations and practical outcomes. You will contribute to the assessment and validation of solutions, identify risks and impacts, and communicate findings to support decision-making and continuous improvement.

Our Frontline Operations group has a variety of roles available, including:
Business Analyst
As a Business Analyst, you will work closely with stakeholders to understand business needs, identify opportunities for improvement and help shape solutions that deliver better outcomes. You will gather and analyse information from a range of sources, translate complex requirements into clear and meaningful documentation, and support informed decision-making. Working collaboratively across teams, you will use your analytical skills to identify challenges, evaluate options and contribute to the successful delivery of business and technology solutions.

Business Intelligence Analyst
As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will analyse and interpret complex data to provide insights that support business decision-making and continuous improvement. You will work with stakeholders to understand business challenges, identify trends, risks and opportunities, and translate data into meaningful information through reports, dashboards and recommendations. Using your analytical expertise, you will help inform strategy, improve business performance and support the delivery of data-driven outcomes across the organisation.

Duties for the above roles may include:
• working collaboratively with stakeholders to understand business needs, challenges and opportunities, and translating these into actionable outcomes
• gathering, analysing and interpreting information from a range of sources to identify trends, risks, issues and opportunities for business improvement
• eliciting, documenting and validating business requirements, processes, user journeys and solution designs to support informed decision-making
• developing, maintaining and enhancing reports, insights, dashboards, business documentation and other artefacts to support operational and strategic outcomes
• providing specialised advice, recommendations and analytical insights to stakeholders on complex business matters
• contributing to the design, implementation and evaluation of business processes, systems and solutions that support organisational objectives
• maintaining accurate, complete and contemporaneous records, documentation and data in accordance with legislative, policy and operational requirements
• supporting continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance business processes, intelligence products, reporting capabilities and service delivery outcomes.

These roles may be offered on an ongoing or non-ongoing basis in Adelaide, Albury, Box Hill (VIC), Brisbane CBD, Burnie, Canberra, Dandenong, Gosford, Hobart, Melbourne CBD, Moonee Ponds, Newcastle, Parramatta, Penrith, Perth, Sydney CBD, Townsville, Upper Mount Gravatt or Wollongong.

We embrace the strength of diversity – through our people and the perspectives they bring.

We are committed to inclusive recruitment practices and encourage applications from people with disability or neurodivergence, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, and individuals from all backgrounds. Reasonable adjustments can be provided throughout the recruitment process.

new_jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst
to support the global Pumps & Seals Aftermarket
business and partner closely with senior commercial operations leadership. This highly visible individual contributor role will analyze complex business data, develop sales, demand, and production forecasts, deliver actionable insights, and support strategic decision-making across a global organization. The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen, advanced analytical capabilities, and experience working with ERP, business intelligence, and reporting systems to improve forecasting accuracy, identify business opportunities and risks, enhance reporting capabilities, and drive commercial performance and operational excellence. This role offers the opportunity to influence key decisions at the highest levels of the organization while collaborating with commercial, operations, supply chain, and finance teams worldwide.

Location:
Houston, TX (Preferred), hybrid

Key Responsibilities

Business Analytics & Insights

Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and key business performance drivers.
Develop actionable insights and recommendations that support commercial and operational decision-making.
Create executive-level reports, dashboards, and KPI analyses for global leadership teams.

Translate business requirements into analytical solutions that improve visibility, decision-making, and performance.

Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve data quality, reporting capabilities, forecasting techniques, and analytical processes.
Recommend and implement enhanced analytics, business intelligence, and planning solutions.
Promote best practices in data analysis, forecasting, reporting, and business performance management.

Forecasting & Planning

Develop, maintain, and continuously improve sales, demand, and production forecasts for the global aftermarket business.
Monitor forecast accuracy, identify variances, and recommend corrective actions to improve predictability.
Partner with commercial, operations, supply chain, and finance teams to align forecasting assumptions and business plans.

Data Management & Reporting

Extract, validate, cleanse, normalize, and analyze data from ERP and other enterprise systems.
Ensure a high level of data accuracy, consistency, integrity, and governance across reporting processes.
Develop and maintain standardized reporting tools, dashboards, and performance metrics.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Economics, Analytics, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in business analysis, commercial analytics, sales forecasting, demand planning, financial planning, or a related analytical role.
Strong experience supporting commercial operations, business planning, and operational decision-making.
Advanced Excel skills, including data modeling, forecasting, scenario analysis, pivot tables, and complex formulas.
Experience working with ERP platforms such as SAP, Oracle, BPC, or similar enterprise systems.
Proven experience developing reports, dashboards, KPIs, and business performance analyses.
Strong data extraction, validation, cleansing, normalization, and quality management skills.
Excellent communication, presentation, collaboration, and stakeholder-management capabilities.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations for senior leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in industrial manufacturing or related industries.
Proficiency in SQL and Power BI for data analysis and reporting.
Knowledge of data integration, enterprise reporting, and data engineering concepts.
Experience with Python for analytics and process automation.
Understanding forecasting, predictive analytics, and demand planning.
Experience supporting global commercial operations and cross-functional teams.
Proven track record of improving forecasting accuracy, reporting, and analytical processes.

Technical Skills

Advanced Microsoft Excel
ERP Systems (SAP, Oracle, BPC, or equivalent)
Power BI and Business Intelligence Reporting Tools
SQL and Database Querying
Data Validation, Cleansing, and Quality Management
Sales, Demand, and Production Forecasting
KPI Development and Performance Analytics
Data Visualization and Executive Reporting
Python (Preferred)
Statistical Analysis and Forecasting Techniques
Enterprise Data Management and Reporting Processes

This role is ideal for a strategic, data-driven analyst who thrives in a fast-paced global environment and enjoys transforming complex data into actionable business insights that drive growth, improve forecasting accuracy, and support executive decision-making.

new_jobs.description:
Requisition Number: 30080

Required Travel: 0 - 10%

Employment Type: Full Time/Hourly/Non-Exempt

Anticipated Salary Range: $71,811.00 - $120,000.00

Security Clearance: Secret

Level of Experience: Mid

This opportunity resides with Warfare Systems (WS)
, a business group within HII’s Mission Technologies division. Warfare Systems comprises cyber and mission IT; electronic warfare; and C5ISR systems.

HII works within our nation’s intelligence and cyber operations communities to defend our interests in cyberspace and anticipate emerging threats. Our capabilities in cybersecurity, network architecture, reverse engineering, software and hardware development uniquely enable us to support sensitive missions for the U.S. military and federal agency partners.

Leadership Mindset at HII – Mission Technologies

Role

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:

Know & Grow Your People – Commit to learning and supporting team success.
Build Relationships – Communicate openly, collaborate well, and build trust.
Take Ownership – Deliver on commitments and take pride in your work.
Customer First – Focus on the mission and those we serve.
Shape the Future – Bring ideas, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
Act with Urgency – Take initiative and follow through with purpose.

These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.

Job Description

HII-Mission Technologies is seeking a Modernization Data Analyst to support the Department of War (DoW) Chief Information Officer (CIO). Come Join our growing team today!

We are seeking a skilled Modernization Data Analyst to support DoW CIO through their IT Modernization effort. This IT transformation is foundational to building a more lethal and ready Joint Force capable of operating in contested environments, which is essential for facing and deterring current and future threats. We encourage you to apply!

This position requires a SECRET level security clearance and will work onsite in Arlington, VA.

Salary for this position will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skill set, while also considering internal equity and market competitiveness.

LEVEL 2 - $73,025 - $104,321

LEVEL 3 - $94,520 - $135,028

Essential Job Responsibilities

Analyze large, complex datasets from multiple legacy and modernized systems to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for optimization.
Collaborate with software engineers, system architects, and cybersecurity teams to ensure data integrity and accessibility across modernization efforts.
Translate technical data findings into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Support data integration activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with Department of War (DoW) data governance standards.
Contribute to the development of data quality metrics and automated validation processes.

Minimum Qualifications

LEVEL 2 - 3 years relevant experience with Bachelors in related field; 1 year relevant experience with Masters in related field.
LEVEL 3 - 6 years relevant experience with Bachelors in related field; 4 years relevant experience with Masters in related field.
Strong understanding of relational databases, ETL processes, and data warehousing concepts.
Familiarity with DoW data security and compliance requirements (e.g., FISMA, NIST standards) is highly desirable.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex findings in a clear, concise manner.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Collaborative team player willing and eager to learn.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a structured environment.
Clearance: A SECRET level security clearance is required.

About The Role

Are you deeply curious about how the media and advertising ecosystem really works under the hood? We are seeking a high-caliber early-career analyst (fresh graduate in Business Management, Technology, or Futuresight-related disciplines) who possesses relentless intellectual curiosity and an appetite to explore the complex intersections that others overlook.

In this role, you will analyze the media ecosystem end-to-end—spanning commercial advertising models, digital distribution mechanics, subscription economics, and emerging tech stacks. You will be expected to thrive in uncertainty, challenge assumptions, and produce rigorous, evidence-backed insights to guide executive decision-making.

Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities

Ecosystem & Vendor Intelligence: Deliver comprehensive vendor dossiers and category analyses within tight timelines, evaluating category fit, integration feasibility, exit costs, vendor viability, and clear decision confidence levels.
End-to-End Media Economics Research: Map and analyze the overlapping dependencies between commercial ad mechanics, audience measurement, first-party data strategies, social tech platforms, and subscription revenue streams.
Rigorous Pilot & Hypothesis Testing: Pre-register every pilot with clear hypotheses, success metrics, stop conditions, and market-as-control measurement designs before execution. Ensure all test results produce actionable, decision-grade findings rather than anecdotal summaries.
Governance & Constraint Screening: Rigorously screen all technical and strategic recommendations against procurement, legal, privacy, and regulatory boundaries before presenting to leadership forums.
Competitive & Supply Chain Tracking: Monitor industry shifts including programmatic supply chain developments, unified sales platforms, broadcaster consolidation, and platform-side API/policy changes.
Quantified Impact: Track, validate, and own the quantification of vendor spend avoided and value unlocked through strategic analysis.

Skills & Qualifications Sought

Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Management, Business Analytics, Technology Information Systems, Innovation Strategy, or a related field (Recent Graduates encouraged).
Structured Research & Synthesis: Exceptional writing and analytical skills with a disciplined focus on writing for executive decision-making rather than word count.
Exceptional Technical Documentation: Expertise in translating complex technical parameters and multi-dimensional tech transformations into clear, visual, and highly structured business summaries (such as matrices and process maps).
Skeptical & Evidence-Driven Mindset: Skeptical by disposition; naturally treats vendor claims and market hype as unproven hypotheses requiring rigorous empirical proof.
Comfort with Uncertainty & Tech Stacks: Eager to navigate complex, multi-layered environments involving programmatic infrastructure, log-level ad data, SSP/ad server reporting, and data clean rooms.
Financial & Statistical Literacy: Capability to build financial models sufficient to size revenue opportunities and integration costs, and statistical literacy to distinguish actual signal from noise.
Uncompromising Integrity: Willingness to state uncertainty explicitly and report negative or failing pilot results clearly without softening outcomes.

This position offers a rare launchpad for a forward-thinking graduate to work at the intersection of business strategy, commercial tech, and future market dynamics. Description

This is a 12 months fixed-term contract.

The Last Mile DSP Payments team wants a Program Manager who’s ready to dive in, get their hands dirty, and learn payments operations from the inside out.

EU DSP Payments moves more than €1B a year across 9 countries — and you’ll get a real, bounded piece of that world to call your own. Think of it as your training ground with teeth: a defined workstream (a payment type, a market, a process) where you’ll build genuine expertise, working closely with a senior PM who’ll show you how the bigger picture fits together.

Key job responsibilities

**What You’ll Do**

Get hands-on executing payment process tasks and improvements within your assigned EU workstream — fuel, incentives, or a focused set of markets — with a senior PM in your corner

Sharpen existing financial controls and audit trails by digging into checks, spotting gaps, and flagging issues fast

Build Excel-based tools and trackers (pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, basic Power Query) that take the manual grind out of day-to-day work

Chase discrepancies within your area, tracing data through upstream systems and partnering with senior teammates to nail the root cause

Document how things actually work — clearly enough that someone else could pick it up, automate it, or scale it

Help capture requirements for automation by getting close to the manual process and spotting exactly where it breaks

A day in the life

You’re sharp with Excel — pivot tables and VLOOKUPs are your bread and butter, and you’re hungry to pick up Power Query

You like structure and you bring it — when something’s messy, you want to be the one organizing it, not just observing it

You communicate clearly and proactively — your manager and stakeholders always know where things stand

You’re a fast learner who doesn’t need everything spelled out twice — new systems and workflows excite you, not intimidate you

You’re open to travel — getting face time with regional ops teams is part of how you’ll grow

You keep your cool under deadline pressure, especially during peak periods

Bonus points for:** curiosity about SQL, interest in BI tools (QuickSight, Tableau), or a second European language

Basic Qualifications

Experience in Excel with advanced proficiency (pivots, lookups, etc.)
Experience working cross-functionally with tech and non-tech teams
Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, operations, supply chain, transportation logistics
