new_jobs.description:
Manage Breakthrough Product Development Programs from Concept to Launch

Fieldpiece
is the innovation leader in professional HVACR test instruments, trusted by technicians around the world to solve some of the industry's toughest challenges. We're investing heavily in the future of product development through modern Fast Time To Market (FTTM) methodologies, connected products, AI-enabled engineering, and customer-centered innovation. Named one of the Best Places to Work in Southern California for four consecutive years
, we're looking for talented people who want to make an impact while growing their careers.

Why This Role?

Great products don't happen by accident - they happen because exceptional leaders bring people, ideas, and execution together.

As our Senior Program Manager
, you'll lead some of Fieldpiece's most strategic new product initiatives while helping transform how we develop products. You'll work across Engineering, Product Management, Industrial Design, Quality, Manufacturing, and global development partners to align teams, remove obstacles, and deliver innovative connected products.

Beyond delivering successful programs, you'll play a key role in advancing our FTTM methodology, helping us continuously improve how we innovate, collaborate, and bring products to market. If you enjoy solving complex challenges, influencing without authority, and turning ambitious ideas into reality, you'll thrive in this role.

This position is in our Orange, CA office with an exciting move to Tustin, CA in 2028.
This role follows a hybrid work schedule
, with employees typically working onsite three days per week. Additional in-office days may be required from time to time for onboarding, training, team meetings, project collaboration, or other business needs.

What You'll Do

Lead multiple, complex new product development programs from concept through commercial launch that include hardware, firmware, and software.
Align cross-functional teams across Product Management, Engineering, Industrial Design, Quality, Operations, and Manufacturing.
Drive program planning, risk management, executive communication, and decision-making.
Coordinate global development activities with suppliers and strategic partners.
Champion Fast Time To Market (FTTM) methodologies and continuous improvement.
Help build a culture of accountability, transparency, and excellence in execution.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

You'll help redefine how an entire company develops products while bringing innovative connected technologies to market faster than ever before.
Shape the future of product development at an innovation-driven company building the next-generation of connected HVACR products by applying FTTM methodologies to accelerate innovation.
Influence both what we build to solve real customer problems and how we build them.
Help drive the adoption of AI-enabled engineering, connected products, and technician productivity solutions in collaboration with global engineering organizations and strategic technology partners.

In Your First Year, You'll Likely Have

Successfully lead multiple new product development programs through key development milestones.
Become a trusted cross-functional leader who helps teams make better, faster decisions.
Embedded FTTM best practices into day-to-day program execution.
Built strong relationships with internal teams and strategic external partners.
Improved program visibility, risk management, and execution predictability.

What You Bring:

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or a related STEM field.
10+ years of program and/or project management experience leading complex new product development initiatives in engineering or manufacturing environments.
A proven track record managing multiple concurrent projects and integrated product programs, aligning cross-functional teams to deliver on schedule.
Experience leading hardware, firmware, and software product development programs from concept through launch.
Strong understanding of the product development lifecycle, including both hardware development and software development processes.
Experience working with global suppliers, ODMs, contract manufacturers, and overseas manufacturing partners.
Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools, including Microsoft Office and modern project tracking software.

Bonus Points If You Have

Experience establishing or improving project governance, stage-gate reviews, PMO structures, or organizational change within a growing or rapidly scaling company.
Experience with Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or Microsoft Project.
Professional certifications such as PMP, Prosci, Lean Six Sigma, or similar.
Experience helping organizations improve program execution through modern product development methodologies.

Why You'll Enjoy Working at Fieldpiece

As a privately held company, we invest for the long term—in our people, our products, and our future. That means we can focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and building lasting careers rather than chasing short-term results.
Work alongside talented, collaborative teammates who are passionate about innovation and solving real world problems.
Make a meaningful impact in a company where your ideas are heard, your expertise is valued, and your contributions help shape the future of our products and business.

Competitive base salary with annual bonus opportunity
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
401(k) with company match and immediate vesting
Generous paid time off and paid holidays
Hire to Retire philosophy - Individual Development Plans for everyone and a commitment to support career development

Teamwork – We collaborate, support one another, and win as a team.

new_jobs.description:
About Harbinger

Harbinger is an American commercial electric vehicle (EV) company on a mission to transform an industry starving for innovation. Harbinger’s best-in-class team of EV, battery, and drivetrain experts have pooled their deep experience to bring a first-of-its-kind EV platform to support the growing demand for medium-duty EVs and Hybrids. Harbinger: Familiar Form, Revolutionary Foundation.

Role Overview

Harbinger is seeking a NPI Project Manager, Supply Chain to drive cross-functional execution and ensure material readiness across our growing vehicle lineup, including the Electric and Plug-in Hybrid Chassis, HC Series Cab, Step Van, and Sevna Cab Chassis platforms. This role sits at the center of Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supplier Development, translating program milestones into supply chain action and keeping production continuity on track through every ramp, launch, and shortage event.

This is a high-visibility, hands-on role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, builds structure where none exists yet, and is comfortable being the single point of accountability for supply readiness on a fast-moving vehicle program.

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end supply chain planning for new product launches and platform ramps, from early design through first-unit shipment and into steady-state production.
Develop and maintain the master NPI / launch timing plan from sourcing through SOP/SORP and ramp-up.
Establish and continuously improve standardized NPI/SCPM methodologies, phase-gate processes, and repeatable playbooks, defining clear roles, escalation paths, and standard work across programs.
Champion for MRP and ISO implementation for the supply chain organization.
Drive shortage management: identify at-risk parts, coordinate expedites and alternate sourcing, and keep production lines running through supply disruptions.
Partner with Engineering to translate design and BOM changes into scalable sourcing and manufacturing plans, and manage the supply chain impact of ECOs/PCOs.
Coordinate cross-functionally across Procurement, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supplier Development to align supply readiness with production build schedules.
Own program-level supply chain schedules, identify critical-path material risks, and proactively mitigate them before they impact the line.
Serve as the central point of contact for your program(s), running status meetings and delivering summaries of risks, decisions needed, and progress.

Required Skills & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience), with 3+ years of experience in supply chain program management, project management, or operations—ideally within automotive, EV, aerospace, or related manufacturing environments.
Experience supporting new product introduction (NPI) programs from concept through production handoff.
Demonstrated success managing shortages and material readiness for production continuity.
Experience with ERP systems and supply chain data/reporting tools (e.g., Oracle, advanced Excel).
Strong track record leading complex, cross-functional projects, with the excellent written and verbal communication skills needed to align internal teams and suppliers.
Proven ability to operate independently, drive root-cause problem solving, and deliver results across competing priorities in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
Willingness to travel periodically to suppliers, service locations, or other operating locations as required.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with vertically integrated manufacturing environments and the interplay between in-house production and outside suppliers.
Knowledge of automotive or commercial vehicle supply chain KPIs and quality/compliance frameworks.
Familiarity with program management methodologies.
Experience standing up or improving program management processes and reporting cadences in a scaling organization.
Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

Key Benefits & Perks

Comprehensive Health, Dental & Vision (HDV) – 100% employee covered
Early-stage Stock Options
Robust Retirement Savings (401k, HSA, FSA)
Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) & Parental Leave
Annual Vacation Bonus
Wellness & Fertility Benefits
Cell Phone Stipend
Complimentary Meals & Stocked Kitchens

California Pay Range

$140,000—$180,000 USD

Equal Opportunity

Harbinger is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Harbinger is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at info@harbingermotors.com.

Candidate Data Privacy

Harbinger may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Harbinger may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) recordkeeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law.

Harbinger may share your Candidate Personal Data with (i) internal personnel who have a need to know such information in order to perform their duties, including individuals on our HR, legal, and finance teams, and the team(s) with the position(s) for which you are applying; (ii) Harbinger affiliates; and (iii) Harbinger’s service providers, including providers of background checks, staffing services, and cloud services.

Harbinger may transfer or store internationally your Candidate Personal Data, including to or in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the European Union and in the cloud, and this data may be subject to the laws and accessible to the courts, law enforcement and national security authorities of such jurisdictions.

Please note that we are currently not accepting applications from third party application services. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand their data needs and deliver actionable insights through reports and dashboards. This is a great opportunity for a detail-oriented individual with a passion for data to contribute to AGA’s success.

Primary Responsibilities

Data Extraction & Cleaning: Gather data from various internal and external sources, ensuring data accuracy and integrity through cleaning, validation, and transformation.
Reporting & Dashboard Development: Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI to visualize key performance indicators (KPIs).
Ad-Hoc Reporting & Analysis: Respond to ad-hoc data requests from business stakeholders, providing timely and accurate reports based on user requests.
Documentation: Document data sources, methodologies, and analytical processes to ensure transparency and reproducibility.
Collaboration with Business Stakeholders: Partner with business users to understand their data needs and translate them into analytical solutions.
Support Financial Forecasting: Assist in the development and refinement of financial forecasting models by providing data analysis and insights.
Process Improvement: Identify and implement opportunities to automate manual reporting processes to improve operational efficiency.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, computer science, economics, or a related field.
Experience: 0-2 years of experience in data analysis or related role.
Programming Proficiency: Working knowledge of at least one programming language for data analysis (Python, R, or similar tool).
Database Skills: Knowledge of database & data warehouse structure, experience using SQL for data extraction and manipulation a plus.
Data Visualization: Strong skills in Microsoft Power BI for creating interactive dashboards and visualizations.
Analytical Skills: Solid understanding of statistical concepts and techniques.

is one of the nation’s leading independent distributors of life, health and wealth insurance products. With a strong insurtech focus, we embrace a broad and innovative approach to serving agents and clients alike. Integrity

Job Summary

The Junior Data Analyst in the Data Analytics Department supports both external client engagements and internal practice groups by delivering data-driven insights and solutions. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to high-impact projects, collaborate across teams, and develop analytical expertise within a fast-growing practice area. Supervisory Responsibilities

None.

Examine collected data to identify trends, outliers, and patterns, providing actionable insights to enhance client efficiency, profitability, or other specified objectives.
Gather and organize data from a variety of sources, including departmental heads, subject matter experts, reports, surveys, forecasts, and budgetary documentation, ensuring accuracy and completeness.

Design and implement secure, efficient, and accurate databases.
Perform data cleaning, transformation, and normalization to ensure consistency and accuracy.
Maintain data integrity and quality controls through validation checks and auditing.
Assist with query development (SQL) to support reporting and analysis.
Document database processes, definitions, and data dictionaries for transparency.
Collaborate with senior analysts or IT teams to support database performance tuning and troubleshooting.
Ensure compliance with data security, privacy, and access control.
Assist in developing and maintaining Python scripts to automate recurring data tasks, reporting, and file processing.
Support the development of ETL workflows that automate data cleaning, validation, and reconciliation to convert raw data into structured, reliable formats.
Apply basic VBA scripting within Excel to streamline reports, calculations, and client deliverables.
Document automation steps and maintain clear records for knowledge sharing and future improvements.
Retrieve, organize, and analyze data from databases to produce accurate and actionable reports.
Build and maintain interactive dashboards in Power BI, using visualization best practices to highlight key metrics and business trends.
Develop automated reporting solutions to reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
Present findings to management and clients with clear, data-driven insights that support decision-making.
Identify potential strategies to address issues uncovered during data analysis and provide well-reasoned suggestions for improvement.

Required

Strong analytical thinking with high attention to detail and accuracy.
Effective communication and presentation skills for staff and stakeholders at all levels.
Excellent organizational and time management skills; able to work independently and proactively.
Proficient in Microsoft Excel (formulas, pivots, Power Query, Power Pivot, DAX, M Code) and the broader Microsoft Office Suite.
Proficient in programming with Python or SQL.
Proficient with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Understanding of database design, structure, and query languages.

Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

Experience with relevant Python libraries (e.g., pandas, tkinter, openpyxl/xlwings, numpy, PDFplumber, sk-learn).
Experience with Machine Learning models and methodologies (Supervised/Unsupervised).
Familiarity with OCR methodologies and tools.
Familiarity with VBA (Visual Basic).
Familiarity with Azure fundamentals.
Prompt engineering and efficient use of utilizing AI.

Physical Requirements

Must be willing to attend in-office meetings when required.

Benefits

Competitive Salary: We value your dedication and hard work. We offer a competitive salary of $60,000-$65,000 per year for this role.

Comprehensive Healthcare: Medical options include HMO, PPO, HDHP, with fully covered dental and vision for you.
Flexible Spending Accounts & Health Savings Accounts: Manage healthcare expenses conveniently with a benefits debit card.

Dependent Care and Pet Insurance: Covering loved ones, furry or not, with flexible spending accounts and pet insurance.

Referral Bonuses: Earn rewards for growing our team and client base.

Support for Professional Certifications: Assistance on your journey to CPA or CFE, including study materials, exam reimbursements, and bonuses.
Leadership Development and Mentorship: Personal and professional growth through mentorship programs and our firm’s competency model (Blueprint for Development).

publicité à l'ensemble du catalogue musical en mode aléatoire, ainsi qu'aux meilleurs

Amazon Music Unlimited afin d'accéder en illimité et à la demande à 100 millions de titres,

dont des millions en HD, Ultra HD et audio spatial ; enfin, chacun peut écouter de la musique

gratuitement en téléchargeant l'application Amazon Music ou via des appareils compatibles

avec Alexa. Rejoignez-nous pour contribuer à façonner la manière dont Amazon Music

interagit avec les fans, les artistes et les créateurs à l'échelle mondiale.

Nous recherchons un(e) Responsable de programme (Program Manager) maîtrisant le

français (langue maternelle ou niveau C2). Vous intégrerez notre équipe International

Product, responsable de l'expérience client dans les nombreux pays où Amazon Music est

présent. Vous contribuerez à améliorer le quotidien de nos clients francophones et à définir

les exigences linguistiques pour les nouvelles fonctionnalités d'Amazon Music qui améliorent

leur expérience musicale. Vos missions consisteront notamment à analyser et résoudre les

problèmes rencontrés par les clients, à identifier les lacunes de l'expérience client (CX) via

des audits de parcours et des workshops, à fournir un support produit et créer des rapports

personnalisés pour les parties prenantes internes et externes, ainsi qu'à accompagner nos

équipes mondiales Produit et QA (Assurance Qualité) pour tester l'expérience locale des

nouvelles fonctionnalités. Nous recherchons une personne à l'aise avec les données et les

produits technologiques pour prendre des décisions et proposer des améliorations de

l'expérience client, et qui s'épanouit dans un environnement dynamique et en évolution

rapide.

English

Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections

between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts,

concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting

intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our

different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music ad-free in shuffle mode,

and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to

Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including

millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading

the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence

how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.

We are looking for a Program Manager (m/f/d) with native / C2 level proficiency in French.

You will be part of our International Product Team that owns the customer experience in our

vast number of Amazon Music supported countries around the world. You will help us

improve the day-to-day experience of our French speaking customers and define language-

specific requirements for new Amazon Music features that make it easier for customers to

fall in love with music. Your focus will be to analyze and fix current customer issues, identify

CX gaps by conducting walk-the-store and workshops, provide product support to and create

customized reports for internal and external stakeholders, and support our global Product

and QA teams to test the local experience of brand-new features. We're looking for

someone who is comfortable working with data and technology products in order to make

decisions and suggest improvements to the CX, and thrives in a fast-paced and dynamic

environment.

Key job responsibilities

Français

Connaissance client : Vous adorez vous mettre à la place des clients, et êtes curieux(se) d'explorer les différentes manières dont ils consomment la musique. Vous tirez des enseignements des retours clients, des données d'utilisation et d'études externes, et alimentez la réflexion de nos chefs de produit grâce à des analyses ponctuelles ou des rapports hebdomadaires/mensuels sur l’expérience client.
Gestion des problèmes : Vous gérez simultanément de nombreuses demandes ponctuelles, tout en priorisant et en résolvant les lacunes de l'expérience client, qu'elles soient internes ou externes. Vous simplifiez des problèmes complexes, produisez des rapports personnalisés grâce à votre capacité à analyser les données, et communiquez efficacement avec les chefs de produit ainsi qu'avec les parties prenantes internes et

externes.

Soutien au lancement de fonctionnalités : Vous incarnez la voix locale du client pour les nouvelles expériences Amazon Music. Vous collaborez étroitement avec les équipes mondiales d'assurance qualité (QA) pour comprendre et vérifier l'expérience client locale. Vous communiquez vos conclusions de manière précise et orientée vers les solutions, tout en sachant trouver le juste équilibre entre rapidité d'exécution et obsession du client.
Soutien éditorial : Vous travaillez avec les équipes éditoriales, de programmation de contenu et de relations avec les labels pour garantir une expérience produit optimale lors de nos campagnes marketing et artistiques. Vous conseillez sur l'expérience visée, puis définissez et mettez en œuvre des solutions créatives pour ravir nos clients.
Benchmarking : Vous êtes l'expert(e) concernant l'expérience client du streaming musical local. Vous comparez notre produit à ceux d'autres fournisseurs internes et externes, et utilisez vos conclusions pour formuler des recommandations à nos chefs de produit.
Gestion des parties prenantes: Vous collaborez avec un large éventail d'interlocuteurs clés, notamment les chefs de produit locaux et mondiaux, le service client, les ingénieurs QA, le marketing, la programmation de contenu et les équipes chargées des relations

avec les artistes et les labels.

Gestion des processus : Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec d'autres chefs de programme et membres de l'équipe à l'élaboration de protocoles et de processus pour les mécanismes existants et futurs. Vous évaluez en permanence les outils et processus de collecte de données et proposez des solutions pour garantir leur efficacité, leur qualité et leur évolutivité.
Adoption de l'IA : Vous identifiez des opportunités d'utiliser des outils d'IA pour optimiser et automatiser des processus tels que l'analyse de l'expérience client, le reporting et le tri des problèmes, réduisant ainsi la charge de travail manuel tout en étendant la couverture géographique. Vous restez à l'affût des capacités émergentes de l'IA et formulez des recommandations concrètes pour améliorer l'efficacité de l'équipe grâce à ces technologies.

English

Customer Insights: You live and breathe customer insights, and are curious to explore the differences in how customers consume music. You derive insights from customer feedback, usage data, and external research, and provide input to our product managers through ad-hoc analyses or weekly/monthly CX reporting.
Issue Management: You manage numerous ad hoc requests concurrently, and prioritize and resolve internal and external customer experience gaps. You simplify complex issues, provide customized reporting with the ability to understand and analyze data, and effectively communicate to product managers, internal and external stakeholders.
Feature Launch Support: You are the local voice of the customer for new Amazon Music experiences. You work closely with global QA to understand and verify the local CX. You communicate findings in a precise and solution oriented manner and are able to walk the fine line between speed and customer obsession.
Editorial support: You work with editorial, content programming and label relations to enable a great product CX for our artist and marketing campaigns. You consult on the desired experience, and define and execute creative solutions to delight our customers. Benchmarking: You are the subject matter expert for the local music streaming CX. You benchmark our product against other internal and external providers, and use your findings to make recommendations to our product managers.
Stakeholder Management: You work with a broad set of key stakeholders including local and global product managers, customer service, quality assurance engineers, marketing, content programming and artist/label relations.
Process Management: You partner closely with other Program Managers and team members on protocol/process development for existing and future mechanisms. You continuously evaluate data collection tools and processes and offer solutions to ensure they are efficient, high quality and scalable.
AI Adoption: You identify opportunities to apply AI tools and automation to streamline processes such as CX analysis, reporting, and issue triage — reducing manual effort while scaling coverage across territories. You stay curious about emerging AI capabilities and bring practical recommendations for where they can improve team efficiency.

Basic Qualifications

Expérience en gestion de programmes ou de projets / Experience in program or project management
Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (oral et écrit) au niveau C2 ou supérieur / Speak, write, and read fluently in French and English at C2 level or above
Expérience dans la facilitation de la collaboration interne entre différentes équipes / Experience driving internal cross-team collaboration

Preferred Qualifications

Connaissance d’outils d'IA généralistes / Knowledge of general AI tools
Expérience dans des tâches ou projets analytiques impliquant le traitement de données / Experience in analytical tasks or projects, working with data
Expérience dans la définition et la mise en œuvre des exigences d'un programme / Experience defining and executing program requirements
Capacité avérée à travailler en autonomie au sein d'une équipe répartie géographiquement, en collaborant efficacement avec des parties prenantes situées sur différents sites et fuseaux horaires / Demonstrated ability to work autonomously within a distributed team, collaborating effectively with stakeholders across multiple locations and time zones
Expérience de travail avec des technologies et des produits numériques / Experience working with technology and digital products

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - Trucking Operations
new_jobs.description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About The Role

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive execution of Applied Intuition's global autonomous trucking programs. You will own the milestones our OEM customers are measured against, lead new operational launches - including standing up operations at new sites, lanes, and regions - and keep engineering, operations, and customer teams moving against a single plan.

This is a hands-on execution role. You will work daily with engineers at Applied Intuition and inside customer organizations, translating Level 4 (L4) autonomy deployment goals into schedules, dependencies, and decisions that hold up under pressure.

At Applied Intuition, You Will

Own program milestones end to end for strategic trucking engagements with global truck OEMs - building the integrated schedule, tracking dependencies across teams, and holding the organization to committed dates.
Lead new operational launches, including bringing up autonomous trucking operations at new sites and routes. You will build the launch plan and sequence work across facilities, fleet, safety, engineering, and local operations through to first revenue miles.
Surface and resolve risk early. Identify gaps before they become slips, drive blockers to resolution rather than escalate them, and make trade-offs visible to the people who need to decide.
Be the source of truth on program status for both working teams and executives - at Applied Intuition and at the customer. This means translating technical detail into decisions leadership can act on, not forwarding status decks.
Work directly with OEM customers and stakeholders to pin down use cases, clarify requirements, and unblock technical challenges across hardware, software, safety, and operations.
Implement operating practices that scale, so the second site launch is faster than the first and the tenth does not require you in the room.
Support business development by contributing to technical proposals and RFQ responses and hosting technology demonstrations for customer and executive audiences.

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

Bachelor's degree in a STEM field or equivalent experience.
5+ years of program or project management experience on advanced software, robotics, or autonomous vehicle programs (ADAS or L4 autonomy), including ownership of hard external deadlines.
Demonstrated ownership of a program launch or operational bring-up -a new site, facility, fleet, route, or region - from plan through steady state.
Track record running programs across distributed teams, sites, and time zones.
Ability to get deep into technical detail: enough systems-level understanding of hardware, software, and field operations to challenge a schedule you are handed rather than just publish it.
Communication skills that work in both directions - credible with engineers in a debug session and with OEM executives in a review.
Willingness to travel internationally to customer and operational sites.

Nice To Have

Direct experience on L4 autonomy programs, particularly trucking or long-haul freight.
Experience in commercial vehicle, logistics, or fleet operations.
Experience working directly with OEM or Tier 1 customers on joint development programs.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Consequently, the parties agree that, as applicable, they will abide by the requirements of 41 CFR 60-1.4(a), 41 CFR 60-300.5(a) and 41 CFR 60-741.5(a) and that these laws are incorporated herein by reference. These regulations prohibit discrimination against qualified individuals based on their status as protected veterans or individuals with disabilities, and prohibit discrimination against all individuals based on their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin. These regulations require that covered prime contractors and subcontractors take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status or disability. The parties also agree that, as applicable, they will abide by the requirements of Executive Order 13496 (29 CFR Part 471, Appendix A to Subpart A), relating to the notice of employee rights under federal labor laws.

Reasonable accommodations are available, requesting an accommodation will not affect your candidacy in any way, and you are not required to disclose the nature of your disability or medical condition in order to make a request.

new_jobs.title: Biomedical Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Biomedical Project Manager

Location: Santa Clara, CA

Duration of Contract: 12+ Months

Pay Rate : $70/hr on W2 all inclusive.

Position Summary
: The Biomedical Project Manager oversees planning, coordination, and delivery of projects involving medical devices, clinical technologies, and healthcare operational systems. The role ensures safe, compliant, and efficient implementation of biomedical equipment across Hospital environments.

Key Responsibilities:

Project Management
— Lead planning, timelines, and execution of biomedical technology projects.
Technology Deployment
— Coordinate installation, integration, and upgrades of medical devices and clinical systems.
Regulatory Compliance
— Ensure adherence to healthcare safety and regulatory standards.
Cross‑Functional Coordination
— Work with clinical staff, IT, Facilities, and vendors to support project goals.
Risk & Safety Oversight
— Identify and mitigate risks related to device reliability and patient safety.
Vendor & Budget Management
— Support procurement, vendor coordination, and budget tracking.

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare Technology Management, Project Management, or related field.

The Engineering Program Manager role at Keurig Dr Pepper is a strategic, leadership-focused position designed to oversee and drive capital projects across multiple manufacturing sites. This remote role requires approximately 50% travel, primarily within the US—specifically to the Northeast and West Coast operations—with limited international travel. Candidates based in the northeastern United States are preferred to facilitate collaboration and onsite engagement. As part of the Multisite Engineering team, the successful candidate will be responsible for developing and executing manufacturing engineering strategies that support the company's growth and productivity objectives. This includes managing capital projects for 6-8 non-carbonated soft drink and food manufacturing facilities, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget. The role involves building strong relationships with internal teams, external suppliers, and stakeholders to coordinate project execution, optimize equipment performance, and implement innovative solutions that enhance capacity and efficiency. The ideal candidate will have experience in managing large-scale manufacturing projects, particularly within the Food and Beverage or Consumer Packaged Goods sectors, with a solid understanding of high-speed filling, packaging equipment, and aseptic technologies. PMP certification, lean methodologies, and a proven track record in executing capital projects from conception through commissioning are essential.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Chemical Engineering.
Minimum of 8 years of experience managing capital engineering projects in a manufacturing environment.
Proven experience managing projects with budgets ranging from $100,000 to $25 million.
PMP certification or the ability to obtain certification within 12 months of employment.
Extensive knowledge of manufacturing technologies including carbonated soft drinks, juices, teas, aseptic processing, fillers, cappers, conveyance systems, packers, palletizers, control systems, reverse osmosis (RO), and Batch/CIP systems.
Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to travel overnight approximately 50% of the time, primarily within the US.
Ability to work independently in a remote setting with minimal supervision.

Responsibilities

Lead the design, development, and execution of capital projects from initial concept through to successful startup and commissioning, ensuring alignment with corporate goals.
Define project performance criteria, develop detailed project timelines, estimate capital budgets, and manage project expenditures effectively.
Make data-driven, methodical decisions that are critical to project success, utilizing key performance metrics and analysis.
Identify opportunities for cost savings and efficiency improvements across the manufacturing network, supporting overall business productivity targets.
Implement lean manufacturing principles and standard work practices to facilitate early equipment management and vertical startups.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with internal stakeholders, external equipment suppliers, and contractors to ensure project alignment and successful implementation—before, during, and after project completion.
Communicate effectively across diverse teams and levels within the organization, providing clarity and updates on project status, risks, and milestones.

401(k) retirement plan with company match to support long-term financial planning.
Tuition reimbursement and mileage reimbursement programs to support personal and professional development.

Track Procurement program progress and ensure visibility into realized vs. projected savings

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology startup helping freight forwarders turn data into better decisions and measurable business impact. Portcast uses AI to surface shipment exceptions, cost risks, and the right actions, helping teams focus on the shipments that need their attention, keep freight costs under control, and make procurement decisions with confidence. Our vision is to be the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.

Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are a lean, globally distributed team building technology for an industry going through a major digital transformation.

About The Role

You'll be the person accountable for the delivery state of our product initiatives once they move into execution. You'll report directly to our Senior Product Manager and make sure ownership is clear across Engineering, Data, and Solutions, work is progressing as expected, dependencies are being managed, and risks are surfaced early rather than when they become launch problems.

We're looking for someone who understands our product, technology, and data well enough to follow the work, understand why we're building something, spot when execution is drifting from the intended outcome, and know when to bring an issue back to Product for clarification.

This is a hands-on IC role and you'll be the first person in this role at Portcast, giving you the opportunity to shape how we manage and deliver product initiatives as we scale. This role requires daily working-hour overlap with our Asia-based Tech Team.

What Success Looks Like In This Role

No launch delays, cleaner releases, and shorter cycle times, driven by earlier identification of risks, dependencies, and blockers, better coordination across Product, Engineering, Data, and Solutions, and clearer visibility into what is moving, what is blocked, and what needs attention.

What You’ll Own

Own delivery from kickoff to release: Take ownership of the operational delivery state once a product initiative moves into execution. Make sure ownership is clear, work starts when expected, progress is visible, and initiatives continue moving through development, testing, and release.
Track dependencies and surface risks early: Monitor cross-functional dependencies, blockers, competing priorities, scope changes, and potential delays.
Coordinate across Product, Engineering, Data, and Solutions: Make sure teams know who owns what, dependencies are understood, and the right people have the context they need. Act as the central point of coordination so Product has a clear view of delivery.
Coordinate handover and launch readiness: Help coordinate the handover between Engineering, Data, Solutions, and Product so that the relevant teams have what they need for testing and acceptance.
Keep execution aligned with product intent: Understand the goals and key requirements behind an initiative well enough to spot when implementation appears to diverge from what was intended. Surface questions, gaps, or inconsistencies early and bring them back to Product for clarification before they become testing or release issues.
Maintain a clear source of truth: Keep tickets, timelines, project status, dependencies, key decisions, and risks up to date so that the team can quickly understand what is moving, what is blocked, and where attention is needed.
Keep delivery moving without creating bureaucracy: Bring structure, follow-through, and accountability to the delivery process without adding unnecessary processes. Join relevant standups and working sessions so you can identify issues and resolve them quickly.

What We’re Looking For

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
At least 3+ years in project management, program management, delivery, product operations, or a similar role.
A proven ability to close things and keep initiatives moving: Experience managing projects or initiatives involving multiple technical and cross-functional teams in a startup or B2B SaaS environment, ideally in data-heavy domains, and even better in logistics tech or supply chain tech.
Understands data and strong technical foundation. You can read code, understand how systems and data pipelines fit together, and dig into the work alongside engineers and data scientists. You know the difference between a real blocker and noise.
Strong execution instincts: You naturally keep track of the details that others might miss. You chase loose ends, surface blockers, follow up on dependencies, and make sure decisions actually turn into action.
First-principles problem solving: When something is stuck or going off track, you understand why rather than simply following the existing process. You work out what needs to change and involve the right people to resolve it.
Comfort with ambiguity: You can create clarity when the requirements, ownership, or process aren't fully defined. You are comfortable making progress without having every answer upfront.
Strong cross-functional communication: You can translate between Product, Engineering, Data, and customer-facing teams. You know what different teams need to know, communicate clearly, and escalate issues early without creating unnecessary noise.
High ownership: You don't see your job as simply tracking whether someone completed a task. You take responsibility for the overall delivery state and stay on an issue until it is actually resolved.

Een technische background in de volgende technologieën is een troef: Java, JEE, Openshift, Rest Web Services, .Net...

new_jobs.title: Program Manager - Research Operations
new_jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews.

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

Participant recruitment at Outset spans a global partner network, internal process, and the product experience itself — and this role owns all three. Rather than running recruitment study by study, you'll build the system that makes it predictable at scale. You'll be Outset's authority on recruitment: the connective tissue between our partners, our teams, and our product.

Responsibilities

Own partner performance and communication, with a system to assess and continually optimize each partner's quality, reliability, and best-fit use cases.
Negotiate preferred rates and commercial terms, and build the feasibility process (incidence rates, targeting, which vendor for which use case) that keeps recruitment predictable as volume grows.
Design and document the end-to-end recruitment process, from intake through delivery — with fill-time benchmarks by audience/screening criteria and a clear playbook for tracking and escalating at-risk projects.
Build the internal enablement and training that gets the GTM team up to speed and confident in how recruitment works.
Partner with Product and Engineering on the recruitment experience — fraud detection, identity verification, quality flagging, refunds — bringing structured, evidence-backed problems into the product roadmap.
Identify and spec internal tooling that reduces manual ops work.
Translate how recruitment works into content for two audiences: best-practice guidance for Account Directors/AEs, and customer-facing explanations of our role, our partners' role, and what to expect.

Qualifications

5–10 years in research operations, participant recruitment, or panel/vendor management, with deep expertise in digital qualitative recruitment; experience with quantitative recruitment is a plus
Hands-on understanding of how participant recruitment actually works: panels and marketplaces, screeners, incidence and feasibility, soft launches, quotas, incentives, fraud, and quality control.
Track record managing vendors and partners — selecting, negotiating, holding accountable, managing spend.
Genuine program management ability — you can hold a messy, cross-functional problem in your head, sequence it, and drive it to a working system.
Experience at both a large organization and a startup. We want the enterprise process instincts and the scrappiness to build fast without waiting for permission.
Strong communicator — able to distill complex, cross-functional information into clear training, documentation, playbooks, and customer-facing content.
Comfortable with AI tooling for content and automation; experience building AI tooling/dashboards a plus.
Highly independent — this role is built for someone who defines priorities as much as executes them.
Bonus: experience at a research platform, panel provider, or research agency.

Compensation Range: $150K - $200K

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology startup helping freight forwarders turn data into better decisions and measurable business impact. Portcast uses AI to surface shipment exceptions, cost risks, and the right actions, helping teams focus on the shipments that need their attention, keep freight costs under control, and make procurement decisions with confidence. Our vision is to be the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.

Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are a lean, globally distributed team building technology for an industry going through a major digital transformation.

About The Role

You'll be the person accountable for the delivery state of our product initiatives once they move into execution. You'll report directly to our Senior Product Manager and make sure ownership is clear across Engineering, Data, and Solutions, work is progressing as expected, dependencies are being managed, and risks are surfaced early rather than when they become launch problems.

We're looking for someone who understands our product, technology, and data well enough to follow the work, understand why we're building something, spot when execution is drifting from the intended outcome, and know when to bring an issue back to Product for clarification.

This is a hands-on IC role and you'll be the first person in this role at Portcast, giving you the opportunity to shape how we manage and deliver product initiatives as we scale. This role requires daily working-hour overlap with our Asia-based Tech Team.

What Success Looks Like In This Role

No launch delays, cleaner releases, and shorter cycle times, driven by earlier identification of risks, dependencies, and blockers, better coordination across Product, Engineering, Data, and Solutions, and clearer visibility into what is moving, what is blocked, and what needs attention.

What You’ll Own

Own delivery from kickoff to release: Take ownership of the operational delivery state once a product initiative moves into execution. Make sure ownership is clear, work starts when expected, progress is visible, and initiatives continue moving through development, testing, and release.
Track dependencies and surface risks early: Monitor cross-functional dependencies, blockers, competing priorities, scope changes, and potential delays.
Coordinate across Product, Engineering, Data, and Solutions: Make sure teams know who owns what, dependencies are understood, and the right people have the context they need. Act as the central point of coordination so Product has a clear view of delivery.
Coordinate handover and launch readiness: Help coordinate the handover between Engineering, Data, Solutions, and Product so that the relevant teams have what they need for testing and acceptance.
Keep execution aligned with product intent: Understand the goals and key requirements behind an initiative well enough to spot when implementation appears to diverge from what was intended. Surface questions, gaps, or inconsistencies early and bring them back to Product for clarification before they become testing or release issues.
Maintain a clear source of truth: Keep tickets, timelines, project status, dependencies, key decisions, and risks up to date so that the team can quickly understand what is moving, what is blocked, and where attention is needed.
Keep delivery moving without creating bureaucracy: Bring structure, follow-through, and accountability to the delivery process without adding unnecessary processes. Join relevant standups and working sessions so you can identify issues and resolve them quickly.

What We’re Looking For

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
At least 3+ years in project management, program management, delivery, product operations, or a similar role.
A proven ability to close things and keep initiatives moving: Experience managing projects or initiatives involving multiple technical and cross-functional teams in a startup or B2B SaaS environment, ideally in data-heavy domains, and even better in logistics tech or supply chain tech.
Understands data and strong technical foundation. You can read code, understand how systems and data pipelines fit together, and dig into the work alongside engineers and data scientists. You know the difference between a real blocker and noise.
Strong execution instincts: You naturally keep track of the details that others might miss. You chase loose ends, surface blockers, follow up on dependencies, and make sure decisions actually turn into action.
First-principles problem solving: When something is stuck or going off track, you understand why rather than simply following the existing process. You work out what needs to change and involve the right people to resolve it.
Comfort with ambiguity: You can create clarity when the requirements, ownership, or process aren't fully defined. You are comfortable making progress without having every answer upfront.
Strong cross-functional communication: You can translate between Product, Engineering, Data, and customer-facing teams. You know what different teams need to know, communicate clearly, and escalate issues early without creating unnecessary noise.
High ownership: You don't see your job as simply tracking whether someone completed a task. You take responsibility for the overall delivery state and stay on an issue until it is actually resolved.
Startup mindset: You enjoy working in a lean environment where there isn't a dedicated person for every function. You're willing to get into the details, solve problems yourself, and build lightweight processes when they are genuinely useful.

What’s In It For You

Own a high-leverage problem: You'll be the person responsible for keeping delivery moving across teams, directly influencing how quickly and reliably we turn product ideas into something customers can use.
Work at the intersection of Product, AI, Data, and Logistics: Our products combine software, data, machine learning, and deep logistics expertise. You'll get exposure to complex product problems where the challenge isn't simply building software, but making sure data, models, workflows, and customer needs come together.
Real impact from day one: we’re lean by design so you'll have a high degree of ownership. There is no large PMO or layer of project managers around you. You'll need to be comfortable getting into the details, figuring things out independently, and knowing when something needs to be pushed, clarified, escalated, or simply solved.
Globally distributed, remote-first flexibility: work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.

OUR CORE VALUES GUIDE EVERYTHING WE DO

Curiosity: We dig into why something's slipping, not just how to patch it. We stay close to the work and the data.
Ownership: We act like founders. We hold a project together end to end and stay on it until it ships cleanly.
Raising the bar: We don't settle for "it launched." We aim for delivery that's predictable, aligned, and free of last-minute surprises.
Effective: We focus on shipping what was actually intended, on time, with real impact, not process for its own sake.

Join us at Portcast in our vision to become the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Public health surveillance, computerized database management, data analysis, program evaluation, literature search, effective verbal and written communication, and interpersonal skills.

High ownership: You don't see your job as simply tracking whether someone completed a task. You take responsibility for the overall delivery state and stay on an issue until it is actually resolved.
Startup mindset: You enjoy working in a lean environment where there isn't a dedicated person for every function. You're willing to get into the details, solve problems yourself, and build lightweight processes when they are genuinely useful.

What’s In It For You

Own a high-leverage problem: You'll be the person responsible for keeping delivery moving across teams, directly influencing how quickly and reliably we turn product ideas into something customers can use.
Work at the intersection of Product, AI, Data, and Logistics: Our products combine software, data, machine learning, and deep logistics expertise. You'll get exposure to complex product problems where the challenge isn't simply building software, but making sure data, models, workflows, and customer needs come together.
Real impact from day one: we’re lean by design so you'll have a high degree of ownership. There is no large PMO or layer of project managers around you. You'll need to be comfortable getting into the details, figuring things out independently, and knowing when something needs to be pushed, clarified, escalated, or simply solved.
Globally distributed, remote-first flexibility: work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.

OUR CORE VALUES GUIDE EVERYTHING WE DO

Curiosity: We dig into why something's slipping, not just how to patch it. We stay close to the work and the data.
Ownership: We act like founders. We hold a project together end to end and stay on it until it ships cleanly.
Raising the bar: We don't settle for "it launched." We aim for delivery that's predictable, aligned, and free of last-minute surprises.
Effective: We focus on shipping what was actually intended, on time, with real impact, not process for its own sake.

Join us at Portcast in our vision to become the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.

As a member of our corporate security team, the Manager – Business Resiliency and Security Operations will be responsible for leading mature, enterprise-wide programs spanning crisis management, emergency response, emergency preparedness, training, and critical-event technology developing. This includes but is not limited to emergency response processes/procedure, crisis management processes/procedures, site threat assessments, ER/CM planning, exercises, automating processes (where possible), employee training programs, etc. The position will also coordinate with event security, travel security, executive protection and administer industry and government/industry regulated security programs (e.g., ISO, OSHA, etc.); while establishing and conducting audit processes with various partners, functional areas, Safety, Security Systems Integration, and Physical Security, to pressure test processes and meet customer (internal and external) requirements.

Crisis Management and Critical Event Operations: Own and continuously improve the enterprise crisis management framework, including plans, playbooks, governance, activation protocols, executive support, after-action reviews, and lessons learned. Training may include all-hazards self-aid, personal and residential security, situational awareness, travel safety, emergency procedures, and other evolving preparedness needs. Plan exercises that pressure-test plans, systems, and decision-making, then convert findings into accountable improvement actions.
Gather and analyze data and make recommendations on operational improvements and risk mitigation to business units. Provide support to business partner engagements, functional areas, and initiatives related to Travel/Event Security, Transportation Security, Workplace Violence Prevention, Special/Sensitive Investigations, and Security Compliance.
Support efforts in Intelligence, GSOC, Travel Security, Event Security, and Executive Protection programs.
Maintain strong relationships with external partners and peer groups.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a relevant discipline (emergency management, business administration, homeland security, crisis management, analytics, intelligence, etc.) is required.
Industry Certification such as PSP, or CPP (or USG/USMIL equivalent cert/s) AND a relevant Resiliency/Crisis Management related Certification (i.e., CCMC, AEM, CEM, CBCP, etc.)
5+ years of demonstrated experience and proficiency in the following areas:
Emergency response, emergency management, and/or crisis management related functions in military, government (local or federal), or large corporate security setting
Building and/or executing security or safety related programs, with demonstrated delivery of finished/refined products
Conducting complex security operations domestically and/or internationally
Writing reports utilizing proper writing mechanics, grammar, clear/consistent formatting, and punctuation.

Prior experience conducting security and/or threat reviews/assessments, developing emergency/crisis response related policies and procedures, and advising on Safety and Security practices

Preferred Qualifications

Graduate degree or equivalent experience in a relevant discipline (emergency management, business administration, homeland security, crisis management, analytics, intelligence, etc.) is required
Preferred Military, Government, or Security experience.
Strong project management experience.
Strong speaking/presentation skills and experience in delivering security solutions to key leaders and c-suite.

new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

The purpose of the Project Manager position is to plan and coordinate projects to meet the overall goals of the project and serve as the main contact with the contractor or owner.

Essential Job Duties

Review shop drawings, contract drawings, specifications, and applicable standards to determine appropriate installation methods.
Generate proposals for change orders, and as assigned.
Determine labor requirements and preparing schedules, track changes.
Order and track material, equipment, tools, and other necessary items based on design and/or contract needs.
Review time for assigned projects and/or contracts to ensure alignment with project budget.
Monitor overall progress of the project and preparing job records
Generate proposals for change orders, RFI’s, ASI’s and MCR’s; communicate approved items into organizational system(s) and/or to designated representative for processing.
Ensure employees follow all relevant safety standards and procedures, work environment in accordance with the SFP standards.
Meet with AHJ’s, contractors, owners, architects, and other design professionals on project progress.
Perform a formal project review with the Fire Alarm Manager weekly, or as requested.
Assist support staff and facilitate closeout documents to include O&Ms and review as-built drawings for accuracy.
Other duties may be assigned.

Qualifications

The qualifications listed below are representative of the elements required to perform the job successfully, however in some cases, an equivalent combination of Education, Training, Certifications and Experience may meet the job qualifications.

Education, Training, Certifications

High School diploma, technical or related experience and/or training, required.
NICET III ITM Water based systems and/or NICET Level IV Fire Alarm, preferred.

Experience, Knowledge, Skill Requirements

5 years’ industry experience, required.
Successful experience in leading multiple projects, achieving goaled outcomes including profitability while communicating with onsite customers, preferred.
Mechanical aptitude, preferred.
Basic and advanced math skills, required.

Communication Skills

Must have the ability to effectively read, write and communicate in English with employees and customers.

Systems And Software Skills

Ability to operate a computer, use Microsoft Office required.

Other Qualifications

Valid driver’s license with acceptable driving record required.
Must be able to comply with SFS’s Drug and Alcohol policy and Background screening requirements, which may also include customer specific requirements based on contractual agreement.

Physical & Work Environment Requirements

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform Essential Job Duties.

Physical Requirements

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to sit for long periods. Employee will occasionally be required to bend, kneel, balance, lift <20lb, walk, stand, ascend/descend stairs, drive, twist, and reach above and below shoulders. Employee will frequently be required to drive and walk for periods.

Work Environment

Employee will consistently be required to work indoors in an office setting, work alone and with other. Employees will occasionally be required to work outside, and be exposed to hot/cold temperatures, dust, fumes, chemicals, electrical hazards and noise. Employee will be occasionally required to wear all appropriate personal protective equipment, as required by company safety policies while visiting locations.

We are fully committed to equal opportunities for employment to all individuals regardless of race, national origin, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, familial status, and any other classification protected under the law. We are an Equal Opportunity, Affirmative Action employer.

While this job description is intended to be an accurate reflection of the position, management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary.

About Us

, a subsidiary of SFP Holding, Inc. (Summit Companies), is a full-service provider for fire detection, suppression, and security with a full suite of capabilities that includes design, installation, testing, inspections, and maintenance. We serve customers across many verticals on a local, regional, and national scale. We’re proud of our well-deserved reputation for quality work that’s completed by our talented and experienced installation workforce. Summit Fire & Security is a dynamic organization with endless growth opportunities spanning over 70 locations in more than 20 states.

Our company is consistently recognized for service excellence in the fire protection industry. Summit Fire & Security supports trade skills and workforce development by hosting Recognized Apprenticeships and on-the-job training (OJT) programs for new career-seekers. Many members of our leadership chair NFPA code compliance committees, serve on regional safety boards, and support technical education in local schools. Summit Fire & Security supports employees in their professional development by offering continued development, training, and education by encouraging NICET and other career-advancing certifications. We offer reimbursement for certain career development programs in addition to potential bonuses for specific certifications. We continually strive to be the Employer of Choice
